<head>

    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">

    <title>منصة النادي الإعلامي - جامعة الطائف</title>
    <meta name="description" content="منصة النادي الإعلامي بجامعة الطائف؛ مساحة للإبداع الإعلامي وتقديم الأفكار واستكشاف الأرشيف وإدارة المسارات.">
    <meta name="keywords" content="النادي الإعلامي, جامعة الطائف, منصة النادي الإعلامي, MTU, Taif University">

    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cairo:wght@400;600;700;800;900&family=Montserrat:wght@800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2"></script>
    <style>
        :root {
            --bg-dark: #07110f;
            --bg-deep: #050b09;
            --bg-card: rgba(13, 27, 24, 0.92);
            --bg-card-solid: #10221d;
            --accent-primary: #0f8b68;
            --accent-glow: #7ce0b6;
            --text-main: #f8fafc;
            --text-muted: #a6b8b0;
            --border: rgba(180, 226, 204, 0.15);
            --input-bg: rgba(4, 16, 13, 0.88);
            --brand-red: #ff4d2d;
            --admin-color: #238636;
            --board-color: #8b5cf6;
        }

        * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: 'Cairo', sans-serif; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }

        body {
            background-color: var(--bg-dark); color: var(--text-main); line-height: 1.7; padding-bottom: 40px; min-height: 100vh; overflow-x: hidden; width: 100%; position: relative;
        }

        .bg-video-container {
            position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; z-index: -99; overflow: hidden; pointer-events: none; background: #000;
        }
        .bg-video-container video {
            position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); min-width: 100%; min-height: 100%; width: auto; height: auto; object-fit: cover;
            filter: brightness(0.5) contrast(1.1);
        }
        .bg-overlay {
            position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; background: rgba(5, 5, 7, 0.7); z-index: -98; pointer-events: none;
        }

        #welcomeScreen {
            position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 999999; 
            background: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 20%, rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.18) 0%, transparent 40%),
                        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 80%, rgba(255, 77, 45, 0.15) 0%, transparent 40%),
                        radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.12) 0%, transparent 60%),
                        #05060a;
            display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 20px; text-align: center; transition: all 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); overflow-y: auto;
        }

        .auth-card {
            position: relative; z-index: 2;
            background: rgba(16, 18, 27, 0.85); 
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); 
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            border-radius: 20px; padding: 32px 24px; width: 100%; max-width: 440px; 
            box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8), 0 0 30px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15); 
            margin-top: 15px; text-align: right;
        }

        .mtu-logo-container { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin-bottom: 8px; position: relative; }
        .mtu-logo-text { font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-size: 3.2rem; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: -1px; color: #ffffff; line-height: 1; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; position: relative; text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255,255,255,0.2); }
        .mtu-dot { width: 14px; height: 14px; background-color: var(--brand-red); border-radius: 50%; display: inline-block; margin-left: 2px; margin-top: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(255, 77, 45, 0.9); }

        .quick-nav {
            position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 1000; background: rgba(15, 15, 20, 0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); padding: 10px 12px; display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; width: 100%; flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .nav-btn {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); color: var(--text-main); border: 1px solid var(--border); padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s ease; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 5px; text-align: center; white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .nav-btn:hover, .nav-btn.active {
            background: var(--accent-primary); color: #ffffff; border-color: var(--accent-glow); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.4);
        }

        header { position: relative; text-align: center; padding: 25px 15px 15px; background: rgba(18, 18, 24, 0.65); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); }
        .site-badge { background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15); color: var(--accent-glow); padding: 6px 20px; border-radius: 30px; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 700; display: inline-block; border: 1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3); }

        .container { max-width: 950px; margin: 20px auto; padding: 0 12px; width: 100%; }
        .page-section { display: none; }
        .page-section.active { display: block; }

        .card { background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--border); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-radius: 14px; padding: 18px 14px; margin-bottom: 20px; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8); }
        .section-title { font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: var(--text-main); }
        .section-title span.icon { background: var(--accent-primary); color: #ffffff; width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 8px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }

        .stats-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr)); gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 20px; }
        .stat-card { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border: 1px solid var(--border); padding: 15px; border-radius: 12px; text-align: center; }
        .stat-num { font-size: 1.8rem; font-weight: 900; color: var(--accent-glow); margin-top: 5px; }
        .stat-label { font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700; }

        .profile-header-card { text-align: center; padding: 25px; }
        .avatar-container { position: relative; width: 95px; height: 95px; margin: 0 auto 12px; }
        .avatar-preview { width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; border: 3px solid var(--accent-primary); background: #1a1a24; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 2rem; color: var(--text-muted); }
        .avatar-upload-btn { position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; background: var(--accent-primary); color: #fff; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; border: 2px solid var(--bg-card); font-size: 1rem; box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); }
        
        .board-hierarchy { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
        .board-tier-1 { display: flex; justify-content: center; }
        .board-tier-2 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(140px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
        .board-tier-3 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(130px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
        .board-card { background: var(--bg-card-solid); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 10px; text-align: center; }
        .board-card.supervisor { background: linear-gradient(145deg, #1e1b4b 0%, #0f172a 100%); width: 100%; max-width: 280px; margin: 0 auto; }
        .board-card.tech-lead { background: linear-gradient(145deg, #0f172a 100%, #1e293b 100%); }
        .board-role { font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent-glow); margin-bottom: 2px; }
        .board-name { font-size: 0.92rem; font-weight: 800; color: #ffffff; }

        .form-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 12px; }
        @media (min-width: 600px) { .form-row { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr)); } }
        .form-group { margin-bottom: 14px; text-align: right; }
        label { display: block; margin-bottom: 5px; font-weight: 700; color: #cbd5e1; font-size: 0.85rem; }
        input, textarea, select { width: 100%; padding: 11px 14px; background-color: var(--input-bg); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; color: var(--text-main); font-size: 0.9rem; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.3s ease; }
        input:focus, select:focus, textarea:focus { border-color: var(--accent-glow); box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.2); }
        
        button.btn-submit { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-primary), #2563eb); color: #ffffff; font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.95rem; padding: 12px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.35); }

        .member-row-item { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border: 1px solid var(--border); padding: 12px; border-radius: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; }

        .archive-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 15px; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; }
        .archive-counter { background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15); color: var(--accent-glow); padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 16px; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; border: 1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3); }
        .archive-grid { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 15px; }
        .idea-card { background: var(--bg-card-solid); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; position: relative; }
        .idea-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; align-items: center; }
        .idea-title { font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 800; color: #fff; }
        .idea-author { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--accent-glow); background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.12); padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 15px; }
        .idea-body { color: #cbd5e1; font-size: 0.88rem; margin-bottom: 12px; }
        .idea-details-meta { display: flex; gap: 12px; font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--text-muted); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; margin-bottom: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
        .status-badge { font-size: 0.72rem; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 700; }
        .status-pending { background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15); color: #fbbf24; border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.3); }
        .status-approved { background: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.15); color: #4ade80; border: 1px solid rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.3); }

        .albums-bar { display: flex; gap: 8px; overflow-x: auto; padding-bottom: 10px; margin-bottom: 15px; }
        .album-chip { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text-muted); padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: 0.2s; }
        .album-chip.active, .album-chip:hover { background: var(--accent-primary); color: #fff; border-color: var(--accent-glow); }

        .gallery-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(180px, 1fr)); gap: 15px; margin-top: 15px; }
        .gallery-item { background: var(--bg-card-solid); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; transition: transform 0.3s ease; position: relative; }
        .gallery-item:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); border-color: var(--accent-primary); }
        .gallery-item img { width: 100%; height: 160px; object-fit: cover; display: block; }
        .delete-img-btn { position: absolute; top: 6px; left: 6px; background: rgba(248,81,73,0.8); color: #fff; border: none; width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 50%; cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.75rem; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }

        .like-btn { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border: 1px solid var(--border); color: #fff; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 0.8rem; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.2s ease; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; }
        .like-btn:hover { background: rgba(59,130,246,0.2); border-color: var(--accent-primary); }

        .video-wrapper { position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 8px; margin-top: 10px; }
        .video-wrapper iframe { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; border: none; }
        .auth-switch { text-align: center; margin-top: 14px; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-muted); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
        .auth-switch a { color: var(--accent-glow); cursor: pointer; font-weight: 700; }
        .error-msg { color: #f85149; font-size: 0.8rem; text-align: center; margin-top: 8px; }
        footer { text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.8rem; padding-top: 20px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); margin-top: 25px; }

        #clubRegModal {
            position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 9999999; 
            background: rgba(3, 4, 8, 0.92); backdrop-filter: blur(15px); 
            display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 20px; text-align: center;
        }

        #customSuccessModal {
            position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 99999999;
            background: rgba(3, 4, 8, 0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
            display: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 20px;
            animation: fadeInModal 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
        }
        @keyframes fadeInModal {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.92); }
            to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
        }
        .modal-card {
            background: rgba(16, 18, 27, 0.95); border: 1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3);
            border-radius: 20px; padding: 30px 24px; text-align: center; max-width: 380px; width: 100%;
            box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8), 0 0 30px rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.2);
        }
        .success-circle-icon {
            width: 70px; height: 70px; background: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.15); border: 2px solid #22c55e;
            color: #22c55e; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
            font-size: 2.2rem; margin: 0 auto 16px; box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.4);
        }
        .modal-title { font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 800; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 8px; }
        .modal-desc { font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 20px; line-height: 1.5; }
        .modal-close-btn {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-primary), #2563eb);
            color: #fff; border: none; padding: 10px 24px; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 800;
            font-size: 0.9rem; cursor: pointer; width: 100%; transition: 0.2s ease;
        }
        .modal-close-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.4); }


        /* MTU premium redesign: deep forest, emerald accents, editorial spacing */
        :root {
            --brand-red: #d7b779;
            --admin-color: #4ade80;
            --board-color: #c4b5fd;
        }
        html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
        body {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 12% 0%, rgba(15,139,104,.18), transparent 38%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 92% 18%, rgba(215,183,121,.10), transparent 30%),
                linear-gradient(180deg, #07110f 0%, #081713 52%, #050b09 100%);
            letter-spacing: .05px;
        }
        .bg-video-container video { filter: brightness(.22) saturate(.72) contrast(1.05); }
        .bg-overlay { background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(4,12,10,.74), rgba(4,12,10,.91)); }
        #welcomeScreen {
            background:
                radial-gradient(circle at 18% 18%, rgba(15,139,104,.24), transparent 38%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 84% 82%, rgba(215,183,121,.13), transparent 34%),
                #07110f;
        }
        #welcomeScreen { pointer-events: auto; }
        #authForm, #authForm input, #authForm button, #authForm a { pointer-events: auto; }
        #authForm input { color: #f8fafc; }
        #authForm input::placeholder { color: #91a99d; opacity: 1; }
        .auth-card, .modal-card {
            background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(17,38,31,.96), rgba(8,20,17,.97));
            border-color: rgba(124,224,182,.24);
            border-radius: 26px;
            box-shadow: 0 28px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.42), 0 0 38px rgba(15,139,104,.09);
        }
        .mtu-logo-text { text-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(124,224,182,.14); }
        .mtu-dot { background: #d7b779; box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(215,183,121,.45); }
        .quick-nav {
            background: rgba(5,17,14,.84);
            border-bottom-color: rgba(124,224,182,.16);
            box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.14);
            padding: 12px 16px;
        }
        .nav-btn {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,.035);
            border-color: rgba(180,226,204,.14);
            border-radius: 14px;
            padding: 9px 14px;
            transition: transform .22s ease, background .22s ease, border-color .22s ease, box-shadow .22s ease;
        }
        .nav-btn:hover, .nav-btn.active {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0f8b68, #116b53);
            border-color: rgba(124,224,182,.6);
            box-shadow: 0 7px 22px rgba(15,139,104,.22);
            transform: translateY(-1px);
        }
        header {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(16,40,32,.7), rgba(7,17,15,.3));
            border-bottom-color: rgba(124,224,182,.14);
            padding: 34px 16px 24px;
        }
        .site-badge, .archive-counter {
            background: rgba(15,139,104,.13);
            color: #a2f0cf;
            border-color: rgba(124,224,182,.25);
        }
        .container { max-width: 1120px; padding: 0 18px; }
        .card {
            background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(15,34,28,.94), rgba(9,23,19,.96));
            border-color: rgba(180,226,204,.14);
            border-radius: 22px;
            padding: 22px;
            box-shadow: 0 18px 45px rgba(0,0,0,.20);
            backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
        }
        .section-title { font-size: 1.2rem; letter-spacing: -.2px; }
        .section-title span.icon {
            background: linear-gradient(145deg, #159b75, #0c654d);
            border-radius: 11px;
            box-shadow: 0 7px 18px rgba(15,139,104,.2);
        }
        .stats-grid { gap: 15px; }
        .stat-card, .board-card, .idea-card, .gallery-item, .member-row-item {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,.025);
            border-color: rgba(180,226,204,.14);
            border-radius: 17px;
        }
        .stat-card { padding: 20px 16px; }
        .stat-num { color: #a2f0cf; }
        .board-card.supervisor { background: linear-gradient(145deg, #154b3b, #0d211b); }
        .board-card.tech-lead { background: linear-gradient(145deg, #102a22, #0b1b16); }
        label { color: #d2e2da; }
        input, textarea, select {
            background-color: rgba(3,14,11,.72);
            border-color: rgba(180,226,204,.16);
            border-radius: 13px;
            padding: 12px 15px;
        }
        input:focus, select:focus, textarea:focus {
            border-color: #7ce0b6;
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(124,224,182,.09);
        }
        button.btn-submit, .modal-close-btn {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #159b75, #0b6a50);
            border-radius: 13px;
            box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(15,139,104,.20);
            transition: transform .2s ease, filter .2s ease;
        }
        button.btn-submit:hover, .modal-close-btn:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); transform: translateY(-1px); }
        .album-chip.active, .album-chip:hover {
            background: #0f8b68; border-color: #7ce0b6;
        }
        .gallery-item:hover { border-color: rgba(124,224,182,.55); }
        .avatar-preview { border-color: #0f8b68; }
        .status-approved { background: rgba(34,197,94,.12); color: #86efac; border-color: rgba(34,197,94,.24); }
        footer { border-top-color: rgba(180,226,204,.13); }
        ::selection { background: rgba(15,139,104,.42); color: #fff; }
        :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7ce0b6; outline-offset: 3px; }
        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            .quick-nav { justify-content: flex-start; flex-wrap: nowrap; overflow-x: auto; }
            .nav-btn { flex: 0 0 auto; }
            .container { padding: 0 12px; }
            .card { padding: 17px 14px; border-radius: 18px; }
            header { padding-top: 26px; }
        }
        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            *, *::before, *::after { scroll-behavior: auto !important; animation-duration: .01ms !important; transition-duration: .01ms !important; }
        }

    

        /* ── MTU Saudi editorial redesign: deep palm green, warm paper, brass gold ── */
        :root {
            --bg-dark: #071b16;
            --bg-deep: #04120f;
            --bg-card: rgba(13, 39, 31, .94);
            --bg-card-solid: #102c23;
            --accent-primary: #b18a45;
            --accent-glow: #e2c27b;
            --text-main: #f5f0e5;
            --text-muted: #b6c4b8;
            --border: rgba(213, 181, 112, .24);
            --input-bg: rgba(3, 18, 14, .94);
            --brand-red: #d7b56d;
            --admin-color: #b18a45;
            --board-color: #d5b56e;
        }
        html { scroll-behavior: smooth; background: #061812; }
        body {
            background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% -12%, rgba(177,138,69,.17), transparent 42%),
                        radial-gradient(ellipse at 100% 55%, rgba(23,83,61,.18), transparent 36%), #061812 !important;
            color: var(--text-main); line-height: 1.85; padding-bottom: 64px;
        }
        body::before { content:""; position:fixed; inset:0; pointer-events:none; z-index:-1; opacity:.16;
            background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, transparent 0 32px, rgba(221,190,124,.08) 33px 34px, transparent 35px 67px); }
        .bg-video-container { opacity:.12; }
        .bg-video-container video { filter: grayscale(.7) sepia(.35) brightness(.38); }
        .bg-overlay { background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(3,18,13,.55),rgba(4,19,14,.88)) !important; }
        #welcomeScreen { background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 15%,rgba(177,138,69,.17),transparent 44%), #061812 !important; }
        #welcomeScreen::before { content:""; position:absolute; width:min(78vw,620px); aspect-ratio:1; border:1px solid rgba(215,181,109,.12); border-radius:50%; box-shadow:0 0 0 32px rgba(215,181,109,.025),0 0 0 80px rgba(215,181,109,.02); pointer-events:none; }
        .auth-card { background:rgba(12,37,29,.94) !important; border:1px solid rgba(215,181,109,.38) !important; border-radius:5px 26px 5px 26px !important; box-shadow:0 28px 90px rgba(0,0,0,.38), inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.04) !important; backdrop-filter:blur(22px); }
        .mtu-logo-text { color:#f6eddb !important; letter-spacing:-2px; text-shadow:0 5px 24px rgba(215,181,109,.18) !important; }
        .mtu-dot { background:#d7b56d !important; box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(215,181,109,.55) !important; }
        .quick-nav { position:sticky; top:0; background:rgba(5,23,17,.94) !important; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(215,181,109,.26) !important; padding:12px clamp(10px,3vw,36px) !important; gap:9px !important; box-shadow:0 12px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.16); }
        .nav-btn { border:1px solid transparent !important; background:transparent !important; border-radius:3px !important; padding:9px 15px !important; color:#d8dfd4 !important; font-size:.83rem !important; transition:all .22s ease !important; }
        .nav-btn:hover,.nav-btn.active { background:rgba(215,181,109,.12) !important; color:#f1d28b !important; border-color:rgba(215,181,109,.4) !important; transform:translateY(-1px); box-shadow:none !important; }
        header { padding:30px 15px 26px !important; background:transparent !important; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(215,181,109,.2) !important; position:relative; }
        header::after { content:""; display:block; width:56px; height:2px; margin:19px auto 0; background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#d7b56d,transparent); }
        .site-badge { background:rgba(215,181,109,.1) !important; color:#e6c77f !important; border:1px solid rgba(215,181,109,.35) !important; border-radius:2px !important; letter-spacing:.04em; }
        .container { max-width:1160px !important; margin:30px auto !important; padding:0 clamp(12px,3vw,30px) !important; }
        .container > .card:first-child { border-radius:3px 14px 3px 14px !important; background:linear-gradient(110deg,rgba(19,55,42,.98),rgba(11,34,26,.95)) !important; border-color:rgba(215,181,109,.28) !important; }
        .card { background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(15,43,33,.97),rgba(8,29,22,.97)) !important; border:1px solid rgba(215,181,109,.19) !important; border-radius:4px 18px 4px 18px !important; padding:clamp(18px,3vw,30px) !important; margin-bottom:24px !important; box-shadow:0 18px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.17) !important; backdrop-filter:blur(12px); }
        .section-title { color:#f2d58e !important; font-size:clamp(1.12rem,2vw,1.45rem) !important; padding-bottom:13px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(215,181,109,.2); margin-bottom:22px !important; }
        .section-title .icon { filter:grayscale(.2); }
        .board-card,.stat-card,.modal-card { background:linear-gradient(145deg,#12382a,#0b241b) !important; border:1px solid rgba(215,181,109,.28) !important; border-radius:3px 14px 3px 14px !important; box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.15) !important; }
        .board-card.supervisor { border-color:#d7b56d !important; background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(119,88,39,.34),rgba(12,43,31,.98)) !important; }
        .board-role,.stat-label { color:#cbbd9a !important; }
        .board-name,.stat-num { color:#f3e7c9 !important; }
        input,select,textarea { background:rgba(3,19,14,.88) !important; border:1px solid rgba(215,181,109,.28) !important; color:#f8f1e2 !important; border-radius:3px 10px 3px 10px !important; padding:12px 14px !important; }
        input:focus,select:focus,textarea:focus { outline:none !important; border-color:#d7b56d !important; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(215,181,109,.12) !important; }
        label { color:#e1d4b6 !important; }
        button,.btn-submit,.avatar-upload-btn { transition:transform .2s ease,background .2s ease,border-color .2s ease !important; }
        .btn-submit { background:linear-gradient(110deg,#d7b56d,#a67a35) !important; color:#14231a !important; border:1px solid #e3c982 !important; border-radius:3px 12px 3px 12px !important; font-weight:900 !important; box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(177,138,69,.15); }
        button:hover,.btn-submit:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); }
        .error-msg { border-radius:3px 10px 3px 10px !important; }
        .album-chip { border-radius:3px 12px 3px 12px !important; border-color:rgba(215,181,109,.25) !important; }
        .album-chip.active { background:#b18a45 !important; color:#102319 !important; }
        .gallery-grid,.archive-grid { gap:18px !important; }
        .gallery-grid > *, .archive-grid > * { border-radius:4px 16px 4px 16px !important; overflow:hidden; }
        .idea-title { color:#f0d28a !important; }
        .status-badge { border-radius:3px 8px 3px 8px !important; }
        .modal-card { border-color:rgba(215,181,109,.4) !important; }
        .heritage-hero { min-height:390px; position:relative; overflow:hidden; isolation:isolate; display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.2fr) minmax(180px,.8fr); align-items:center; gap:24px; margin:0 0 28px; padding:clamp(28px,5vw,64px); border:1px solid rgba(215,181,109,.45); border-radius:4px 26px 4px 26px; background:linear-gradient(115deg,rgba(9,35,25,.98) 0%,rgba(12,47,34,.96) 58%,rgba(31,58,39,.93) 100%); box-shadow:0 28px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.25); }
        .heritage-hero::before { content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:-1; opacity:.23; background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,transparent 0 24px,rgba(215,181,109,.13) 25px 26px,transparent 27px 52px); mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,#000,transparent 80%); }
        .heritage-hero::after { content:""; position:absolute; left:-90px; bottom:-160px; width:360px; height:360px; border:1px solid rgba(215,181,109,.22); border-radius:50%; box-shadow:0 0 0 24px rgba(215,181,109,.025),0 0 0 50px rgba(215,181,109,.025),0 0 0 82px rgba(215,181,109,.02); z-index:-1; }
        .hero-content { position:relative; z-index:2; }
        .hero-kicker { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; color:#d7bb79; font-size:.82rem; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.04em; margin-bottom:20px; }
        .hero-kicker-dot { width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:#e1c477; box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(225,196,119,.12); }
        .hero-content h1 { font-size:clamp(2.1rem,5vw,4.6rem); line-height:1.22; letter-spacing:-.045em; color:#f7f0e2; font-weight:900; margin:0 0 18px; }
        .hero-content h1 span { color:#dfc17a; }
        .hero-content p { color:#c2d0c2; max-width:530px; font-size:clamp(.94rem,1.5vw,1.08rem); line-height:2; margin-bottom:25px; }
        .hero-actions { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; gap:11px; }
        .hero-primary,.hero-secondary { cursor:pointer; font-family:'Cairo',sans-serif; font-weight:900; padding:12px 20px; border-radius:3px 12px 3px 12px; }
        .hero-primary { background:linear-gradient(115deg,#e2c77e,#b18a45); border:1px solid #ead18d; color:#12271c; box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(177,138,69,.18); }
        .hero-primary span { font-size:1.2rem; margin-right:10px; }
        .hero-secondary { background:rgba(255,255,255,.025); border:1px solid rgba(215,181,109,.45); color:#f0d89a; }
        .hero-seal { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; justify-self:center; width:clamp(180px,23vw,280px); aspect-ratio:1; border:1px solid rgba(215,181,109,.6); border-radius:50%; padding:13px; transform:rotate(-7deg); box-shadow:0 0 0 8px rgba(215,181,109,.04),0 0 0 22px rgba(215,181,109,.025),inset 0 0 45px rgba(215,181,109,.06); }
        .seal-inner { width:100%; height:100%; border:1px dashed rgba(215,181,109,.55); border-radius:50%; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:6px; color:#dfc17a; }
        .seal-ar { font-size:clamp(2.5rem,5vw,4.5rem); line-height:1.2; font-weight:900; letter-spacing:-.07em; }
        .seal-en { font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif; font-size:.64rem; letter-spacing:.18em; color:#d8c89f; }
        .seal-line { width:45px; height:1px; background:#d7b56d; margin:5px 0; }
        .seal-caption { font-size:.78rem; color:#c8d2c5; }
        .hero-orbit { position:absolute; border:1px solid rgba(215,181,109,.16); border-radius:50%; pointer-events:none; }
        .orbit-one { width:180px; height:180px; right:38%; top:-140px; }
        .orbit-two { width:90px; height:90px; right:42%; top:-95px; }
        .hero-footer { position:absolute; bottom:0; left:0; right:0; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; padding:12px clamp(20px,4vw,48px); border-top:1px solid rgba(215,181,109,.18); color:#9eb0a1; font-size:.72rem; letter-spacing:.04em; background:rgba(2,17,12,.18); }
        .hero-footer-mark { color:#e1c47b; font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif; font-weight:900; letter-spacing:.1em; }
        .hero-footer-mark i { font-style:normal; margin-right:7px; }
        @media (max-width:700px) {
            .heritage-hero { grid-template-columns:1fr; min-height:0; padding:28px 22px 62px; gap:22px; }
            .hero-seal { width:150px; grid-row:1; margin:4px auto 0; }
            .seal-ar { font-size:2.5rem; }
            .hero-content { grid-row:2; }
            .hero-content h1 { font-size:clamp(2.25rem,10vw,3.5rem); }
            .hero-content p { font-size:.94rem; }
            .hero-footer { font-size:.65rem; padding:10px 15px; }
            .quick-nav { justify-content:flex-start !important; overflow-x:auto; flex-wrap:nowrap !important; }
            .nav-btn { flex-shrink:0; }
            .container { margin-top:16px !important; }
            .card { padding:17px !important; }
        }
        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *,*::before,*::after { scroll-behavior:auto !important; transition:none !important; animation:none !important; } }

h4,.event-item h4{color:#f5dda0;margin-bottom:4px}.item-meta{font-size:12px;color:#b6c8bd;display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}.status-pill{display:inline-flex;border-radius:999px;padding:3px /* ===== Royal Luxury Identity v2: motion + refined responsive layout ===== */
:root{--sa-green:#073B2A;--sa-gold:#D8B56A;--sa-cream:#F7F0DF;--sa-muted:#c6cbbb;--sa-deep:#031c14;--sa-line:rgba(216,181,106,.28)}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:90px}
body{background:var(--sa-deep);color:var(--sa-cream)}
#publicLanding{background:var(--sa-deep);overflow:hidden}
.public-nav{height:70px;padding-inline:clamp(18px,5vw,76px);background:rgba(3,28,20,.88);border-bottom:1px solid var(--sa-line);box-shadow:0 8px 32px #0002}
.public-brand{gap:10px}.brand-seal{width:40px;height:40px;border:1px solid var(--sa-gold);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 4px #d8b56a10,0 0 22px #d8b56a12;transition:transform .5s,box-shadow .5s}.public-brand:hover .brand-seal{transform:rotate(-12deg) scale(1.06);box-shadow:0 0 24px #d8b56a3a}
.public-nav nav{gap:clamp(12px,2vw,30px)}.public-nav nav a{position:relative;color:#e7e4d8;text-decoration:none;transition:color .25s}.public-nav nav a:after{content:"";position:absolute;right:0;bottom:-9px;width:0;height:2px;background:var(--sa-gold);transition:width .28s}.public-nav nav a:hover{color:var(--sa-gold)}.public-nav nav a:hover:after{width:100%}
.public-login,.outline-button{border-radius:999px;border-color:#d8b56a9c;transition:transform .25s,background .25s,box-shadow .25s}.public-login:hover,.outline-button:hover{background:#d8b56a16;transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 8px 24px #d8b56a16}
.public-hero{min-height:min(640px,calc(100vh - 70px));margin:0 clamp(10px,2.5vw,38px);border-radius:0 0 24px 24px;grid-template-columns:1.04fr .96fr;gap:20px;padding:clamp(24px,4vw,64px);background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 24% 50%,rgba(216,181,106,.12),transparent 38%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 15%,rgba(53,112,75,.24),transparent 42%),linear-gradient(115deg,#05271c 0%,#073b2a 58%,#0b2a20 100%)}
.public-hero:before{width:600px;height:600px;left:-260px;bottom:-380px;border-color:#d8b56a24;box-shadow:0 0 0 24px #d8b56a08,0 0 0 55px #d8b56a05,0 0 0 90px #d8b56a03;animation:slowOrbit 34s linear infinite}
.public-hero:after{width:360px;height:360px;left:32%;top:-230px;bottom:auto;border-color:#d8b56a20;animation:slowOrbit 27s linear infinite reverse}
.hero-copy{position:relative;z-index:2;animation:riseIn .9s both}.hero-kicker{color:var(--sa-gold);letter-spacing:.04em}.hero-content h1,.hero-copy h1{font-size:clamp(2.7rem,5.5vw,5.6rem);line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:-.035em}.hero-description{max-width:610px;color:#d2d9ce}.hero-actions{gap:13px}.gold-button{border-radius:12px;padding:16px 26px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#f0d99a,#d8b56a 55%,#b99043);box-shadow:0 12px 34px #d8b56a20;position:relative;overflow:hidden}.gold-button:before{content:"";position:absolute;top:-50%;left:-80%;width:45%;height:200%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#ffffff65,transparent);transform:rotate(20deg);transition:left .7s}.gold-button:hover:before{left:140%}.gold-button:hover{box-shadow:0 14px 35px #d8b56a30}
.hero-art{min-height:430px;isolation:isolate}.hero-art:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:7% 3%;border:1px solid #d8b56a20;clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 0,100% 100%,0 80%);background:linear-gradient(145deg,#d8b56a0a,transparent 60%);z-index:-1}.art-orbit{border-color:#d8b56a99;box-shadow:0 0 0 20px #d8b56a09,0 0 0 45px #d8b56a06,0 0 45px #d8b56a12;animation:softPulse 6s ease-in-out infinite}.orbit-two{border-color:#d8b56a55;animation:slowOrbit 42s linear infinite}.art-stamp{width:clamp(210px,23vw,300px);height:auto;aspect-ratio:1;border:1px solid #e4c87f;background:radial-gradient(circle at 40% 30%,#174d36ed,#05271deF 70%);box-shadow:0 0 0 8px #d8b56a0b,0 0 60px #0004, inset 0 0 45px #d8b56a0b;animation:stampFloat 7s ease-in-out infinite}.stamp-ar{font-size:clamp(58px,6vw,82px);text-shadow:0 8px 24px #0004}.art-caption{border-top:1px solid #d8b56a30}.art-star{animation:starTurn 24s linear infinite}.hero-bottom{border-top-color:#d8b56a30}
.public-section{padding:clamp(48px,6vw,88px) clamp(20px,6vw,100px);position:relative}.public-intro{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#06291e,#073b2a 65%,#08271d)}.intro-grid{gap:clamp(28px,5vw,76px)}.value-strip>div{border-color:#d8b56a35;transition:background .25s,transform .25s}.value-strip>div:hover{background:#d8b56a0c;transform:translateY(-4px)}
.public-tracks{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f7f0df,#efe4cb);color:#12372a;border-color:#d8b56a55}.public-tracks .section-index,.public-tracks .track-card>span{color:#8b6b34}.public-tracks .section-heading>p{color:#526257}.public-tracks .section-heading h2{color:#0b3325}.track-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px}.track-card{border-radius:15px;overflow:hidden;min-height:220px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#0b3b2b,#05271c);border-color:#d8b56a55;box-shadow:0 10px 28px #10271b10;transition:transform .35s,border-color .35s,box-shadow .35s}.track-card:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#d8b56a13,transparent 44%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}.track-card:hover{transform:translateY(-8px);border-color:#c69d4d;box-shadow:0 18px 35px #10271b20}.track-card:hover:before{opacity:1}.track-icon{width:52px;height:52px;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid #d8b56a66;border-radius:50%;background:#d8b56a0c}.track-card h3{color:#f7f0df}.track-card p{color:#c5d0c4}
.public-team{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#073b2a,#041e16)}.team-photo{border-radius:18px;border-color:#d8b56a80;box-shadow:0 20px 55px #0003}.team-photo img{transition:transform 1.2s cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.25,1),filter .7s}.team-photo:hover img{transform:scale(1.035);filter:saturate(1.04)}.team-photo:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(0deg,#031c14a8,transparent 36%);opacity:.35}
.public-archive,.public-cta{background:#f7f0df;color:#12372a}.archive-copy p,.public-cta p{color:#536357}.public-cta .gold-button{color:#09271c}.public-footer{background:#031c14;border-top:1px solid #d8b56a45}
/* Entrance reveals: content remains visible if JS is disabled */
.js-reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(22px);transition:opacity .7s ease,transform .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}.js-reveal.is-visible{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}.track-card.js-reveal:nth-child(2){transition-delay:.06s}.track-card.js-reveal:nth-child(3){transition-delay:.12s}.track-card.js-reveal:nth-child(4){transition-delay:.18s}.track-card.js-reveal:nth-child(5){transition-delay:.24s}.track-card.js-reveal:nth-child(6){transition-delay:.3s}
@keyframes riseIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}@keyframes stampFloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(-5deg)}50%{transform:translateY(-10px) rotate(-2deg)}}@keyframes softPulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 20px #d8b56a09,0 0 0 45px #d8b56a05,0 0 38px #d8b56a0c}50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 26px #d8b56a0b,0 0 0 55px #d8b56a07,0 0 55px #d8b56a18}}@keyframes slowOrbit{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}@keyframes starTurn{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
@media(max-width:900px){.public-nav{gap:12px;padding-inline:16px}.public-nav nav{gap:12px}.public-hero{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;min-height:560px;padding:28px}.hero-art{min-height:350px}.art-stamp{width:220px}.track-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:640px){.public-nav{height:auto;min-height:66px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:12px 15px}.public-nav nav{order:3;width:100%;overflow-x:auto;justify-content:flex-start;padding:8px 0 3px}.public-nav nav a{white-space:nowrap;font-size:12px}.public-brand b{font-size:13px}.public-brand small{font-size:9px}.public-login{padding:10px 13px;font-size:12px}.public-hero{margin:0 8px;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:0;padding:28px 20px 56px;min-height:0}.hero-art{grid-row:1;min-height:240px}.art-stamp{width:185px}.art-orbit{width:220px}.orbit-two{width:195px}.hero-copy{grid-row:2}.hero-copy h1{font-size:clamp(2.6rem,12vw,4rem)}.hero-bottom{font-size:9px}.public-section{padding:44px 18px}.section-heading,.team-heading{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}.track-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.track-card{min-height:185px;padding:20px}.team-photo img{max-height:420px}.value-strip{gap:8px}.value-strip>div{padding:12px 8px}.js-reveal{transform:translateY(14px)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.js-reveal{opacity:1;transform:none;transition:none}.art-orbit,.art-stamp,.art-star,.public-hero:before,.public-hero:after{animation:none!important}html{scroll-behavior:auto}}

</style>
</head>
<body>

    <div class="bg-video-container">
        <video autoplay loop muted playsinline preload="auto">
            <source src="background.mp4" type="video/mp4">
            <source src="https://assets.mixkit.co/videos/preview/mixkit-abstract-technology-mesh-network-30230-large.mp4" type="video/mp4">
        </video>
    </div>
    <div class="bg-overlay"></div>

    <div id="customSuccessModal">
        <div class="modal-card">
            <div class="success-circle-icon" id="modalIcon">✓</div>
            <div class="modal-title" id="modalTitle">تمت العملية بنجاح!</div>
            <div class="modal-desc" id="modalDesc">تم رفع البيانات وتحديث المنصة بنجاح.</div>
            <button class="modal-close-btn" onclick="closeSuccessModal()">موافق</button>
        </div>
    </div>


    <div id="publicLanding" dir="rtl">
      <header class="public-nav">
        <a class="public-brand" href="#publicHome"><span class="brand-seal">إ</span><span><b>النادي الإعلامي</b><small>جامعة الطائف · MTU</small></span></a>
        <nav><a href="#aboutClub">عن النادي</a><a href="#tracks">المسارات</a><a href="#clubPhoto">أعضاء النادي</a><a href="#publicArchive">الأرشيف</a></nav>
        <button class="public-login" onclick="openPublicLogin()">دخول المنصة <span>←</span></button>
      </header>
      <main>
        <section class="public-hero" id="publicHome">
          <div class="hero-copy">
            <span class="eyebrow"><i></i> جامعة الطائف · النادي الإعلامي</span>
            <p class="hero-kicker">مساحة تصنع الفرق</p>
            <h1>نروي الحكاية،<br><em>ونصنع الأثر.</em></h1>
            <p class="hero-description">مساحة تجمع المواهب الإعلامية لصناعة محتوى يعبّر عن الجامعة، ويواكب التحوّل، ويترك أثرًا.</p>
            <div class="hero-actions"><button class="gold-button" onclick="openPublicLogin()">ابدأ رحلتك معنا <span>←</span></button><a class="outline-button" href="#aboutClub">اكتشف النادي <span>↓</span></a></div>
            <div class="hero-footnote"><span>رؤية إبداعية</span><b>✳</b><span>هوية وطنية</span><b>✳</b><span>صوت الجامعة</span></div>
          </div>
          <div class="hero-art" aria-label="هوية النادي الإعلامي">
            <div class="art-orbit orbit-one"></div><div class="art-orbit orbit-two"></div>
            <div class="art-stamp"><span class="stamp-ar">إعلام</span><span class="stamp-en">MEDIA · MTU</span><i></i><small>صوت الجامعة</small></div>
            <div class="art-caption"><span>01 / 04</span><b>نصنع الحكاية من قلب الحدث</b></div>
            <span class="art-star">✳</span>
          </div>
          <div class="hero-bottom"><span>TAIF UNIVERSITY · MEDIA CLUB</span><span>من الفكرة إلى الأثر</span></div>
        </section>

        <section class="public-intro public-section" id="aboutClub">
          <div class="section-index">01 <span>—</span> من نحن</div>
          <div class="intro-grid"><h2>نمنح الفكرة<br><em>صوتًا وصورة.</em></h2><div><p>النادي الإعلامي مساحة طلابية تجمع الشغف بالممارسة، وتحوّل الأفكار إلى قصص ومحتوى وتجارب إعلامية تعكس روح جامعة الطائف.</p><button class="text-link" onclick="openPublicLogin()">اكتشف مساحتك داخل النادي <span>←</span></button></div></div>
          <div class="value-strip"><div><b>01</b><span>نبتكر</span><small>أفكار تبدأ من سؤال</small></div><div><b>02</b><span>ننتج</span><small>محتوى يستحق المشاهدة</small></div><div><b>03</b><span>نؤثر</span><small>حكايات تبقى في الذاكرة</small></div></div>
        </section>

        <section class="public-tracks public-section" id="tracks">
          <div class="section-heading"><div><div class="section-index">02 <span>—</span> مساراتنا</div><h2>لكل موهبة، <em>مساحة.</em></h2></div><p>اختر المجال الذي يشبهك، وابدأ بتحويل شغفك إلى تجربة إعلامية حقيقية.</p></div>
          <div class="track-grid">
            <article class="track-card"><span>01 / VISUAL</span><div class="track-icon">◉</div><h3>تصوير وإضاءة</h3><p>التقاط اللحظة وصناعة صورة تحكي أكثر من ألف كلمة.</p></article>
            <article class="track-card"><span>02 / MOTION</span><div class="track-icon">▷</div><h3>مونتاج وموشن</h3><p>إيقاع بصري يحوّل اللقطات إلى قصة متكاملة.</p></article>
            <article class="track-card"><span>03 / SOUND</span><div class="track-icon">∿</div><h3>برامج وبودكاست</h3><p>أصوات وأفكار وحوارات تستحق أن تُسمع.</p></article>
            <article class="track-card"><span>04 / DESIGN</span><div class="track-icon">✳</div><h3>تصميم وهوية</h3><p>لغة بصرية واضحة تمنح كل فكرة شخصيتها.</p></article>
            <article class="track-card"><span>05 / WORDS</span><div class="track-icon">“</div><h3>كتابة وصحافة</h3><p>صياغة الحكاية وصناعة محتوى يلامس الجمهور.</p></article>
            <article class="track-card"><span>06 / DIGITAL</span><div class="track-icon">⌘</div><h3>تقنية وإعلام رقمي</h3><p>أدوات رقمية وتجارب تفتح آفاقًا جديدة للإبداع.</p></article>
          </div>
        </section>

        <section class="public-team public-section" id="clubPhoto">
          <div class="section-index">03 <span>—</span> مجتمعنا</div>
          <div class="team-heading"><h2>وجوه خلف <em>الحكاية.</em></h2><p>فريق يجمعه الشغف، وتوحّده الرغبة في تقديم محتوى يليق بالجامعة.</p></div>
          <figure class="team-photo"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="أعضاء النادي الإعلامي بجامعة الطائف مجتمعون في لقاء للنادي" loading="lazy"><figcaption><span>MEDIA CLUB · TAIF UNIVERSITY</span><b>فريق واحد، حكايات كثيرة.</b></figcaption></figure>
        </section>

        <section class="public-archive public-section" id="publicArchive">
          <div class="archive-decoration">أرشيف<br><em>اللحظات</em></div><div class="archive-copy"><div class="section-index">04 <span>—</span> الأرشيف</div><h2>كل لحظة<br>لها <em>حكاية.</em></h2><p>اكتشف أعمال النادي وذكرياته ومحتواه الإبداعي من مكان واحد.</p><button class="gold-button" onclick="openPublicLogin()">ادخل إلى الأرشيف <span>←</span></button></div>
        </section>

        <section class="public-cta"><span class="eyebrow"><i></i> خطوتك القادمة تبدأ هنا</span><h2>فكرتك تستحق<br><em>أن تُروى.</em></h2><p>انضم إلى مساحة الإبداع، وكن جزءًا من الحكاية الإعلامية.</p><button class="gold-button" onclick="openPublicLogin()">دخول منصة النادي <span>←</span></button></section>
      </main>
      <footer class="public-footer"><a class="public-brand" href="#publicHome"><span class="brand-seal">إ</span><span><b>النادي الإعلامي</b><small>جامعة الطائف · MTU</small></span></a><span>رؤية إبداعية · هوية وطنية</span><a href="#publicHome">العودة للأعلى ↑</a></footer>
    </div>

<style>
:root{--sa-green:#071d16;--sa-green2:#0d3023;--sa-green3:#153d2c;--sa-gold:#d9b96e;--sa-cream:#f6f0df;--sa-muted:#b7c5b9}
#publicLanding{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:999990;overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:hidden;background:#071d16;color:var(--sa-cream);font-family:'Cairo',sans-serif;scroll-behavior:smooth}
#publicLanding *{box-sizing:border-box}
#publicLanding button,#publicLanding a{font:inherit}
#publicLanding button{cursor:pointer}
.public-nav{height:78px;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:30;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:25px;padding:0 clamp(20px,5vw,86px);background:rgba(5,24,17,.9);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(217,185,110,.2);backdrop-filter:blur(18px)}
.public-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;color:var(--sa-cream);text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap}.brand-seal{width:42px;height:42px;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid var(--sa-gold);border-radius:50%;color:var(--sa-gold);font-size:25px;font-weight:900}.public-brand b{display:block;font-size:15px}.public-brand small{display:block;color:var(--sa-muted);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1px}
.public-nav nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:clamp(14px,2.7vw,42px)}.public-nav nav a{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#d4dbce;text-decoration:none;transition:color .2s}.public-nav nav a:hover{color:var(--sa-gold)}
.public-login,.outline-button{background:transparent;color:var(--sa-gold);border:1px solid rgba(217,185,110,.6);padding:12px 19px;border-radius:4px;font-weight:800}.public-login span,.gold-button span{margin-right:13px}
.public-hero{position:relative;min-height:min(700px,calc(100vh - 78px));margin:0 clamp(16px,5.4vw,100px);border:1px solid rgba(217,185,110,.35);border-top:0;border-radius:0 0 34px 34px;overflow:hidden;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.02fr 1fr;align-items:center;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 45%,rgba(54,103,68,.28),transparent 45%),linear-gradient(130deg,#08251a,#103525 70%,#183b2a)}
.public-hero:before,.public-hero:after{content:"";position:absolute;pointer-events:none;border:1px solid rgba(217,185,110,.09);border-radius:50%;width:520px;height:520px;left:-230px;bottom:-330px;box-shadow:0 0 0 25px rgba(217,185,110,.025),0 0 0 55px rgba(217,185,110,.02)}
.public-hero:after{width:320px;height:320px;left:auto;right:43%;top:-265px;bottom:auto}
.hero-copy{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:65px 4vw 70px 6vw}.eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;color:var(--sa-gold);font-size:14px;font-weight:800}.eyebrow i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--sa-gold);box-shadow:0 0 0 7px #d9b96e22}
.hero-kicker{margin-top:42px;color:#c6d1c4;font-size:17px;font-weight:700}.hero-copy h1{font-size:clamp(48px,5.7vw,88px);line-height:1.25;letter-spacing:-2px;margin:10px 0 18px;font-weight:900;color:#faf5e8}.hero-copy h1 em,.public-section h2 em,.public-cta h2 em,.archive-copy h2 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--sa-gold)}.hero-description{font-size:clamp(15px,1.3vw,19px);line-height:2;color:#c1cec2;max-width:650px}.hero-actions{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:34px}.gold-button{background:linear-gradient(130deg,#e8ce87,#c49c4e);border:1px solid #efdca4;color:#10251a;padding:16px 25px;border-radius:4px;font-weight:900;box-shadow:0 12px 30px #0002;transition:transform .2s,filter .2s}.gold-button:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);filter:brightness(1.06)}.outline-button{text-decoration:none;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:18px}.hero-footnote{display:flex;gap:15px;align-items:center;margin-top:52px;font-size:12px;color:#aebfae}.hero-footnote b{color:var(--sa-gold)}
.hero-art{min-height:510px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;position:relative}.art-orbit{position:absolute;width:min(34vw,420px);aspect-ratio:1;border:1px solid #d9b96e88;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 0 24px #d9b96e06,0 0 0 48px #d9b96e04}.orbit-two{width:min(31vw,380px);border-style:dashed;transform:rotate(24deg)}.art-stamp{width:280px;height:280px;border:1px solid var(--sa-gold);border-radius:50%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transform:rotate(-7deg);background:radial-gradient(circle,#143a29aa,#09231955);box-shadow:0 0 50px #0002}.stamp-ar{font-size:80px;font-weight:900;color:var(--sa-gold);line-height:1.1}.stamp-en{font:800 12px 'Montserrat',sans-serif;letter-spacing:2px;color:#e7d5a8}.art-stamp i{width:55px;height:1px;background:var(--sa-gold);margin:16px 0}.art-stamp small{font-size:14px;color:#c6d1c4}.art-caption{position:absolute;bottom:28px;left:8%;right:8%;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;font-size:12px;color:#a8b9a8}.art-caption span{color:var(--sa-gold);letter-spacing:1px}.art-star{position:absolute;top:13%;right:18%;font-size:26px;color:var(--sa-gold)}
.hero-bottom{grid-column:1/-1;position:absolute;bottom:0;right:0;left:0;border-top:1px solid #d9b96e22;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:17px 4%;font-size:11px;color:#a9b7a8}.hero-bottom span:first-child{font-weight:900;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--sa-gold)}
.public-section{padding:100px clamp(22px,9vw,150px)}.section-index{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:1px;color:var(--sa-gold);font-weight:900}.section-index span{opacity:.55;margin:0 8px}.intro-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10%;align-items:center;margin-top:35px}.public-section h2{font-size:clamp(37px,4.3vw,62px);line-height:1.35;margin:0;font-weight:900}.intro-grid p,.section-heading>p,.team-heading p,.archive-copy p{color:#b9c8bb;font-size:16px;line-height:2.1}.text-link{margin-top:20px;background:none;border:0;color:var(--sa-gold);font-weight:800}.text-link span{margin-right:12px}.value-strip{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);margin-top:70px;border-top:1px solid #d9b96e35;border-bottom:1px solid #d9b96e35}.value-strip>div{padding:24px 28px;display:grid;gap:5px;border-left:1px solid #d9b96e25}.value-strip>div:last-child{border-left:0}.value-strip b{color:#b8a16a;font-size:12px}.value-strip span{font-size:23px;font-weight:900}.value-strip small{color:#9fb2a3}
.public-tracks{background:#0a281d;border-top:1px solid #d9b96e20;border-bottom:1px solid #d9b96e20}.section-heading{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:35px;margin-bottom:42px}.section-heading h2{margin-top:16px}.section-heading>p{max-width:360px}.track-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:15px}.track-card{min-height:245px;padding:25px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#123727,#0a241a);border:1px solid #d9b96e27;position:relative;transition:transform .25s,border-color .25s}.track-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);border-color:#d9b96e88}.track-card>span{font:700 10px 'Montserrat',sans-serif;letter-spacing:1px;color:#a5b6a6}.track-icon{color:var(--sa-gold);font-size:34px;margin:20px 0 8px}.track-card h3{font-size:20px;margin-bottom:8px}.track-card p{font-size:13px;color:#aebfb0;line-height:1.9}
.public-team{background:#071d16}.team-heading{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:30px;margin:25px 0 35px}.team-heading p{max-width:390px}.team-photo{margin:0;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #d9b96e66;background:#10281e}.team-photo img{display:block;width:100%;max-height:620px;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 42%;filter:saturate(.84);transition:transform .8s}.team-photo:hover img{transform:scale(1.015)}.team-photo figcaption{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:20px;padding:20px 25px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#0b261c,#143526);color:var(--sa-gold)}.team-photo figcaption span{font:800 10px 'Montserrat',sans-serif;letter-spacing:1.5px}.team-photo figcaption b{color:#f4ecd7;font-size:15px}
.public-archive{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;align-items:center;gap:8%;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#133b2a,#0a251b);border-top:1px solid #d9b96e22;border-bottom:1px solid #d9b96e22}.archive-decoration{font-size:clamp(62px,9vw,135px);line-height:1.1;font-weight:900;color:#d9b96e17;border:1px solid #d9b96e3a;aspect-ratio:1.1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;transform:rotate(-5deg)}.archive-decoration em{font-style:normal;color:#d9b96e66}.archive-copy h2{font-size:clamp(42px,5vw,72px);margin:22px 0}.archive-copy p{margin-bottom:25px}
.public-cta{text-align:center;padding:100px 20px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 100%,#1d4932,#071d16 70%);border-bottom:1px solid #d9b96e30}.public-cta h2{font-size:clamp(48px,6vw,82px);line-height:1.3;margin:25px 0 12px}.public-cta p{color:#b9c8bb;margin-bottom:30px}.public-footer{padding:25px clamp(22px,5vw,80px);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:20px;background:#04150f;color:#9eb0a1;font-size:12px}.public-footer>a:last-child{color:var(--sa-gold);text-decoration:none}
@media(max-width:900px){.public-nav{padding:0 20px}.public-nav nav{gap:12px}.public-nav nav a{font-size:11px}.public-hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;margin:0 12px}.hero-copy{padding:55px 8% 85px}.hero-art{min-height:350px;grid-row:1}.hero-copy{grid-row:2}.hero-kicker{margin-top:10px}.art-orbit{width:290px}.orbit-two{width:260px}.art-stamp{width:210px;height:210px}.stamp-ar{font-size:62px}.hero-bottom{font-size:9px}.public-section{padding:75px 6%}.track-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:600px){.public-nav{height:auto;min-height:70px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:12px 16px;gap:12px}.public-brand b{font-size:13px}.public-brand small{font-size:9px}.brand-seal{width:36px;height:36px}.public-nav nav{order:3;width:100%;overflow-x:auto;padding:4px 0 2px;justify-content:flex-start}.public-nav nav a{white-space:nowrap}.public-login{padding:9px 12px;font-size:12px}.public-hero{min-height:auto}.hero-art{min-height:300px}.art-orbit{width:245px}.orbit-two{width:215px}.art-stamp{width:175px;height:175px}.stamp-ar{font-size:52px}.stamp-en{font-size:9px}.art-caption{font-size:10px}.hero-copy{padding:30px 7% 80px}.hero-copy h1{font-size:48px;letter-spacing:-1px}.hero-description{font-size:14px}.hero-footnote{gap:8px;margin-top:30px;font-size:10px}.hero-bottom{padding:12px 4%;font-size:8px}.intro-grid,.public-archive{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:30px}.intro-grid p{margin-top:20px}.value-strip{margin-top:40px}.value-strip>div{padding:15px 10px}.value-strip span{font-size:18px}.value-strip small{font-size:10px}.section-heading,.team-heading{display:block}.section-heading>p,.team-heading p{margin-top:15px}.track-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.track-card{min-height:200px}.public-section h2{font-size:40px}.team-photo img{min-height:280px;object-fit:cover}.team-photo figcaption{display:block}.team-photo figcaption b{display:block;margin-top:8px}.archive-decoration{max-height:260px}.public-footer{flex-wrap:wrap}.public-footer .public-brand{width:100%}}
</style>

    <div id="welcomeScreen">
        <div class="mtu-logo-container"><div class="mtu-logo-text">MTU<span class="mtu-dot"></span></div></div>
        <span class="site-badge" style="margin-top: 4px; background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2);">منصة النادي الإعلامي</span>
        <h1 id="authMainTitle" style="font-size: 1.25rem; margin-top: 12px; color: #fff; font-weight: 800;">تسجيل الدخول للمنصة</h1>
        
        <div class="auth-card">
            <form id="authForm" onsubmit="handleSupabaseAuth(event)">
                <div class="form-group" id="fullNameGroup" style="display: none;">
                    <label>الاسم الرباعي:</label>
                    <input type="text" id="authFullName" placeholder="اكتب اسمك الرباعي هنا" oninput="checkBoardIdentity(this.value)">
                    <div id="boardNotice" style="display: none; font-size: 0.8rem; color: #8b5cf6; margin-top: 5px; font-weight: bold; background: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.15); padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.3);">
                        🌟 أهلاً بك! تطابق اسمك مع الهيكلة الإدارية، وتم إعفاؤك من المسارات.
                    </div>
                </div>
                
                <div class="form-group" id="phoneGroup" style="display: none;">
                    <label>رقم الجوال:</label>
                    <input type="tel" id="authPhone" placeholder="05XXXXXXXX">
                </div>

                <div class="form-group" id="trackGroup" style="display: none;">
                    <label>اختر مسارك الرئيسي في النادي:</label>
                    <select id="authTrack">
                        <option value="تصوير وإضاءة">📷 تصوير وإضاءة</option>
                        <option value="مونتاج وموشن جرافيك">🎬 مونتاج وموشن جرافيك</option>
                        <option value="إنتاج برامج وبودكاست">🎙️ إنتاج برامج وبودكاست</option>
                        <option value="تصميم وهوية بصرية">🎨 تصميم وهوية بصرية</option>
                        <option value="كتابة وصحافة إعلامية">✍️ كتابة وصحافة إعلامية</option>
                        <option value="تقنية المعلومات (IT)">💻 تقنية المعلومات (IT)</option>
                    </select>
                </div>
                <div class="form-group"><label>البريد الإلكتروني:</label><input type="email" id="authEmail" placeholder="name@example.com" required></div>
                <div class="form-group"><label>كلمة المرور:</label><input type="password" id="authPassword" placeholder="••••••••" required></div>
                <button type="submit" class="btn-submit" id="authBtn"><span id="authBtnText">دخول المنصة</span><span>🚀</span></button>
                <div id="authError" class="error-msg"></div>
            </form>

            <div class="auth-switch">
                <div><span id="switchText">ليس لديك حساب على المنصة؟</span> <a onclick="toggleAuthMode()" id="switchLink">إنشاء حساب جديد</a></div>
                <hr style="border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); margin: 8px 0;">
                <div>
                    <button type="button" onclick="openClubRegisterModal()" style="background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15); border: 1px solid var(--accent-primary); color: var(--accent-glow); padding: 10px 15px; border-radius: 10px; width: 100%; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.85rem; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px;">
                        <span>📝 التسجيل في النادي الإعلامي (طلب عضوية)</span>
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div id="clubRegModal" style="display: none;">
        <div class="mtu-logo-container"><div class="mtu-logo-text">MTU<span class="mtu-dot"></span></div></div>
        <span class="site-badge" style="margin-top: 5px;">استمارة طلب انضمام للنادي الإعلامي</span>
        
        <div class="auth-card" style="max-width: 500px; max-height: 85vh; overflow-y: auto;">
            <form id="clubRegisterForm" onsubmit="submitClubRegistration(event)">
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>الاسم الرباعي:</label>
                    <input type="text" id="regFullName" placeholder="الاسم الرباعي كما هو معتمد" required>
                </div>
                <div class="form-row">
                    <div class="form-group">
                        <label>البريد الجامعي:</label>
                        <input type="email" id="regUnivEmail" placeholder="sXXXXX@tu.edu.sa" required>
                    </div>
                    <div class="form-group">
                        <label>الرقم الجامعي:</label>
                        <input type="text" id="regUnivId" placeholder="44XXXXXXXX" required>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="form-row">
                    <div class="form-group">
                        <label>رقم الجوال:</label>
                        <input type="tel" id="regPhone" placeholder="05XXXXXXXX" required>
                    </div>
                    <div class="form-group">
                        <label>اختر مسارك المفضل:</label>
                        <select id="regTrack">
                            <option value="تصوير وإضاءة">📷 تصوير وإضاءة</option>
                            <option value="مونتاج وموشن جرافيك">🎬 مونتاج وموشن جرافيك</option>
                            <option value="إنتاج برامج وبودكاست">🎙️ إنتاج برامج وبودكاست</option>
                            <option value="تصميم وهوية بصرية">🎨 تصميم وهوية بصرية</option>
                            <option value="كتابة وصحافة إعلامية">✍️ كتابة وصحافة إعلامية</option>
                            <option value="تقنية المعلومات (IT)">💻 تقنية المعلومات (IT)</option>
                        </select>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label>نبذة عنك (مهاراتك واهتماماتك):</label>
                    <textarea id="regBio" placeholder="اكتب نبذة مختصرة عن شغفك..." rows="3" required></textarea>
                </div>
                <div style="display: flex; gap: 10px;">
                    <button type="submit" class="btn-submit" id="regSubmitBtn" style="flex: 2;"><span>إرسال طلب الانضمام</span><span>📩</span></button>
                    <button type="button" onclick="closeClubRegisterModal()" style="background: rgba(248,81,73,0.2); border: 1px solid rgba(248,81,73,0.4); color: #f85149; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 15px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; flex: 1;">إلغاء</button>
                </div>
                <div id="regError" class="error-msg"></div>
            </form>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- شريط التنقل العلوي مع زر المساعد الذكي المضاف -->
    <nav class="quick-nav">
        <button class="nav-btn active" onclick="switchPage('homePage', this)">🏛️ المجلس</button>
        <button class="nav-btn" onclick="switchPage('profilePage', this)">👤 بروفايلي</button>
        <button class="nav-btn" onclick="switchPage('formPage', this)">💡 تقديم فكرة</button>
        <button class="nav-btn" onclick="switchPage('archivePage', this)">📁 الأرشيف</button>
        <button class="nav-btn" onclick="switchPage('galleryPage', this)">🖼️ معرض الصور</button>
        <button class="nav-btn" onclick="switchPage('tasksPage', this)">📌 التكليفات</button>
        <button class="nav-btn" onclick="switchPage('calendarPage', this)">🗓️ التقويم</button>
        <button class="nav-btn" onclick="switchPage('aiAssistantPage', this)">🤖 المساعد الذكي</button>
        <button class="lang-toggle" id="languageToggle" onclick="toggleLanguage()" aria-label="Switch language">EN</button>
        <button class="nav-btn" id="adminNavBtn" style="display: none; background: rgba(35, 134, 54, 0.2); border-color: var(--admin-color);" onclick="switchPage('adminPage', this)">⚙️ المشرف</button>
        <button class="nav-btn" onclick="logout()" style="background: rgba(248, 81, 73, 0.15); border-color: rgba(248, 81, 73, 0.3); color: #f85149;">🚪 خروج</button>
    </nav>

    <header>
        <div class="mtu-logo-container" style="margin-bottom: 3px;"><div class="mtu-logo-text" style="font-size: 2.2rem;">MTU<span class="mtu-dot" style="width: 10px; height: 10px;"></span></div></div>
        <br><span class="site-badge">النادي الإعلامي</span>
    </header>

    <div class="container">

        <div class="card" style="padding: 12px 20px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px;">
            <div>👤 أهلاً بك: <strong id="barUserName" style="color: var(--accent-glow);">...</strong></div>
            <div>المسار: <span id="barUserTrack" style="background: rgba(59,130,246,0.15); padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(59,130,246,0.3);">عضو</span></div>
            <div>الرتبة: <span id="barUserRole" style="background: rgba(35,134,54,0.15); padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 10px; color: #4ade80;">عضو</span></div>
        </div>

        <section id="homePage" class="page-section active">
            <div class="heritage-hero">
                <div class="hero-orbit orbit-one"></div><div class="hero-orbit orbit-two"></div>
                <div class="hero-content">
                    <div class="hero-kicker"><span class="hero-kicker-dot"></span> جامعة الطائف · النادي الإعلامي</div>
                    <h1>نروي الحكاية،<br><span>ونصنع الأثر.</span></h1>
                    <p>مساحة تجمع المواهب الإعلامية لصناعة محتوى يعبّر عن الجامعة، ويواكب التحوّل، ويترك أثرًا.</p>
                    <div class="hero-actions">
                        <button class="hero-primary" onclick="switchPage('formPage', document.querySelector('[onclick*=\"formPage\"]'))">قدّم فكرتك <span>←</span></button>
                        <button class="hero-secondary" onclick="switchPage('galleryPage', document.querySelector('[onclick*=\"galleryPage\"]'))">استكشف الأرشيف</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="hero-seal" aria-hidden="true"><div class="seal-inner"><span class="seal-ar">إعلام</span><span class="seal-en">MEDIA · MTU</span><span class="seal-line"></span><span class="seal-caption">صوت الجامعة</span></div></div>
                <div class="hero-footer"><span>رؤية إبداعية · هوية وطنية</span><span class="hero-footer-mark">MTU <i>✳</i></span></div>
            </div>
            <section class="showreel-panel" aria-label="عرض النادي">
              <div class="showreel-layout">
                <div class="showreel-screen">
                  <video controls muted playsinline preload="metadata" poster="" aria-label="عرض مرئي للنادي">
                    <source src="background.mp4" type="video/mp4">
                    <source src="https://assets.mixkit.co/videos/preview/mixkit-abstract-technology-mesh-network-30230-large.mp4" type="video/mp4">
                  </video>
                  <span class="showreel-tag">MTU · MEDIA SHOWREEL</span>
                </div>
                <div class="showreel-copy">
                  <span class="eyebrow">01 — من خلف الكواليس</span>
                  <h3>الحكاية تبدأ<br>من <span style="color:#d8b56a">فريق واحد.</span></h3>
                  <p>لقطات من عالم النادي الإعلامي؛ حيث تتحول الأفكار إلى مشاهد، والتعاون إلى أثر يبقى.</p>
                  <button class="gold-mini" onclick="switchPage('galleryPage', document.querySelector('[onclick*=\"galleryPage\"]'))">شاهد أعمال النادي ←</button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </section>
            <div class="card">
                <h2 class="section-title"><span class="icon">👥</span>مجلس النادي وهيكلة الإدارة</h2>
                <div class="board-hierarchy">
                    <div class="board-tier-1"><div class="board-card supervisor"><div class="board-role">مشرف النادي</div><div class="board-name">د. حمزه فرج</div></div></div>
                    <div class="board-tier-2">
                        <div class="board-card"><div class="board-role">رئيس النادي</div><div class="board-name">عبدالرحمن علي الزهراني</div></div>
                        <div class="board-card"><div class="board-role">نائب الرئيس</div><div class="board-name">ماجد الشاطري</div></div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="board-tier-3">
                        <div class="board-card"><div class="board-role">عضو مجلس الإدارة</div><div class="board-name">نواف عبد الله المالكي</div></div>
                        <div class="board-card"><div class="board-role">عضو مجلس الإدارة</div><div class="board-name">حمد عايض الحارثي</div></div>
                        <div class="board-card"><div class="board-role">عضو مجلس الإدارة</div><div class="board-name">عبد الله مزيد السواط</div></div>
                        <div class="board-card"><div class="board-role">عضو مجلس الإدارة</div><div class="board-name">عبد الرحمن نجم العتيبي</div></div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="board-tier-3">
                        <div class="board-card tech-lead" style="grid-column: 1 / -1; max-width: 320px; margin: 0 auto; width: 100%;">
                            <div class="board-role">مسؤول تقنية المعلومات (IT)</div><div class="board-name">خالد أحمد الهلال</div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </section>

        <!-- صفحة معرض الصور -->
        <section id="galleryPage" class="page-section">
            <div class="card">
                <h2 class="section-title"><span class="icon">🖼️</span>معرض صور فعاليات النادي</h2>
                
                <div style="background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border: 1px solid var(--border); padding: 15px; border-radius: 12px; margin-bottom: 20px;">
                    <h3 style="font-size: 0.95rem; margin-bottom: 12px; color: var(--accent-glow);">➕ إدارة المعرض (رفع جماعي وإنشاء ألبومات):</h3>
                    
                    <div class="form-row" style="margin-bottom: 10px;">
                        <div class="form-group">
                            <label>إنشاء ألبوم / مجلد جديد:</label>
                            <div style="display: flex; gap: 8px;">
                                <input type="text" id="newAlbumName" placeholder="مثال: ورشة التصوير 2026">
                                <button type="button" onclick="createNewAlbum()" style="background: var(--accent-primary); border: none; color: #fff; padding: 0 15px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap;">إنشاء</button>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="form-group">
                            <label>اختر الألبوم المستهدف:</label>
                            <select id="targetAlbumSelect">
                                <option value="الفعاليات العامة">الفعاليات العامة (افتراضي)</option>
                            </select>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <form id="uploadGalleryForm" onsubmit="uploadMultipleGalleryImages(event)">
                        <div class="form-row">
                            <div class="form-group" style="grid-column: 1 / -1;">
                                <label>اختر صور متعددة من الجهاز (حفظ دائم في سوبابيس):</label>
                                <input type="file" id="galleryImageFiles" accept="image/*" multiple required style="padding: 8px;">
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <button type="submit" class="btn-submit" id="uploadGalleryBtn"><span>رفع وحفظ الصور المحددة</span><span>🚀</span></button>
                    </form>
                </div>

                <div class="albums-bar" id="albumsBarContainer">
                    <div class="album-chip active" onclick="filterGalleryByAlbum('الكل', this)">📁 الكل</div>
                </div>
                
                <div class="gallery-grid" id="dynamicGalleryContainer">
                    <div style="text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted); grid-column: 1 / -1; padding: 20px;">جاري جلب الصور المحفوظة...</div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </section>

        <!-- صفحة المساعد الذكي المستقلة الكبيرة الجديدة -->
        <section id="aiAssistantPage" class="page-section">
            <div class="card" style="padding: 24px; min-height: 75vh; display: flex; flex-direction: column;">
                <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 15px; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px;">
                    <h2 class="section-title" style="margin-bottom: 0;"><span class="icon">🤖</span>مساعد الذكاء الاصطناعي - النادي الإعلامي</h2>
                    <div style="display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap;">
                        <button type="button" onclick="clearAiConversation()" style="background:rgba(248,81,73,.12);border:1px solid rgba(248,81,73,.35);color:#ff8b82;padding:6px 12px;border-radius:20px;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;">🧹 محادثة جديدة</button>
                        <button type="button" id="voiceToggleBtn" onclick="toggleVoiceOutput()" style="background: rgba(59,130,246,0.15); border: 1px solid var(--accent-primary); color: var(--accent-glow); padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;">
                            🔊 الصوت: <span id="voiceStatusText">مفعل (صوت واضح وفصيح)</span>
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <p style="color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.85rem; margin-bottom: 15px;">
                    مساعدك الذكي لتطوير الأفكار، مراجعة التقارير، والدعم الفني للمنصة. تحدث بالميكروفون أو اكتب وسأتفاعل معك بشكل حقيقي وفوري!
                </p>

                <!-- أزرار الخدمات السريعة -->
                <div style="display: flex; gap: 8px; overflow-x: auto; padding-bottom: 10px; margin-bottom: 15px;">

                        <option value="مونتاج وموشن جرافيك">مونتاج</option>
                        <option value="إنتاج برامج وبودكاست">بودكاست</option>
                        <option value="تصميم وهوية بصرية">تصميم</option>
                        <option value="كتابة وصحافة إعلامية">كتابة</option>
