    <script>
        const SUPABASE_URL = 'https://hlgvjdknxtywdqjikayz.supabase.co';
        const SUPABASE_ANON_KEY = 'sb_publishable_xw3iN_Cb5eFA125MyBx8TQ_3aTyXjqr';
        const supabaseClient = supabase.createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY);
        supabaseClient.auth.onAuthStateChange((_event, session) => {
            // currentUser is also managed by the existing application auth flow.
            if (session && session.user) currentUser = session.user;
            if (typeof loadAiConversation === 'function') loadAiConversation();
        });
        
        const ADMIN_NAMES = ["خالد الهلال", "خالد أحمد الهلال", "حمزه فرج", "حمزة فرج", "د. حمزه فرج", "د. حمزة فرج", "عبدالرحمن الزهراني", "عبدالرحمن علي الزهراني", "ماجد الشاطري"];
        const BOARD_NAMES = ["نواف المالكي", "نواف عبد الله المالكي", "حمد الحارثي", "حمد عايض الحارثي", "عبدالله السواط", "عبد الله مزيد السواط", "عبدالرحمن العتيبي", "عبد الرحمن نجم العتيبي"];

        let currentUser = null;
        let isRegisterMode = false;
        let uploadedAvatarBase64 = '';
        let allMembersData = [];
        let allIdeasData = [];
        let galleryData = [];
        let albumsList = ["الفعاليات العامة"];
        let currentSelectedAlbum = "الكل";

        function showSuccessModal(title, message, icon = '✓') {
            document.getElementById('modalIcon').innerText = icon;
            document.getElementById('modalTitle').innerText = title;
            document.getElementById('modalDesc').innerText = message;
            document.getElementById('customSuccessModal').style.display = 'flex';
        }

        function closeSuccessModal() {
            document.getElementById('customSuccessModal').style.display = 'none';
        }

        function createNewAlbum() {
            const input = document.getElementById('newAlbumName');
            const albumName = input.value.trim();
            if (!albumName) { showSuccessModal('تنبيه', 'يرجى كتابة اسم الألبوم أولاً.', '⚠️'); return; }
            if (albumsList.includes(albumName)) { showSuccessModal('تنبيه', 'هذا الألبوم موجود مسبقاً.', '⚠️'); return; }

            albumsList.push(albumName);
            input.value = '';
            updateAlbumsUI();
            showSuccessModal('تم بنجاح', `تم إنشاء ألبوم "${albumName}" بنجاح!`, '📁');
        }

        function updateAlbumsUI() {
            const selectEl = document.getElementById('targetAlbumSelect');
            const barEl = document.getElementById('albumsBarContainer');
            
            selectEl.innerHTML = '<option value="الفعاليات العامة">الفعاليات العامة (افتراضي)</option>';
            albumsList.forEach(album => {
                if(album !== "الفعاليات العامة") {
                    selectEl.innerHTML += `<option value="${album}">${album}</option>`;
                }
            });

            barEl.innerHTML = `<div class="album-chip ${currentSelectedAlbum==='الكل'?'active':''}" onclick="filterGalleryByAlbum('الكل', this)">📁 الكل</div>`;
            albumsList.forEach(album => {
                barEl.innerHTML += `<div class="album-chip ${currentSelectedAlbum===album?'active':''}" onclick="filterGalleryByAlbum('${album}', this)">📁 ${album}</div>`;
            });
        }

        async function loadGalleryFromSupabase() {
            const container = document.getElementById('dynamicGalleryContainer');
            try {
                const { data, error } = await supabaseClient.from('gallery').select('*');
                if (error) throw error;
                galleryData = data || [];
                
                galleryData.forEach(item => {
                    if (item.album && !albumsList.includes(item.album)) {
                        albumsList.push(item.album);
                    }
                });
                updateAlbumsUI();
                renderGalleryGrid(galleryData);
            } catch (err) {
                container.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted); grid-column: 1 / -1; padding: 20px;">لا توجد صور محفوظة بعد.</div>';
            }
        }

        function renderGalleryGrid(items) {
            const container = document.getElementById('dynamicGalleryContainer');
            container.innerHTML = '';
            
            const filtered = currentSelectedAlbum === 'الكل' ? items : items.filter(i => i.album === currentSelectedAlbum);

            if (filtered.length === 0) {
                container.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted); grid-column: 1 / -1; padding: 20px;">لا توجد صور في هذا الألبوم.</div>';
                return;
            }

            filtered.forEach(item => {
                const card = document.createElement('div');
                card.className = 'gallery-item';
                card.innerHTML = `
                    <img src="${item.image_url}" alt="صورة النادي" loading="lazy" onerror="this.src='https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1517245386807-bb43f82c33c4?auto=format&fit=crop&w=600&q=80'">
                    <button class="delete-img-btn" onclick="deleteGalleryItem('${item.id}')" title="حذف الصورة">×</button>
                `;
                container.appendChild(card);
            });
        }

        function filterGalleryByAlbum(albumName, btnEl) {
            currentSelectedAlbum = albumName;
            document.querySelectorAll('.album-chip').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
            btnEl.classList.add('active');
            renderGalleryGrid(galleryData);
        }

        async function uploadMultipleGalleryImages(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const btn = document.getElementById('uploadGalleryBtn');
            const fileInput = document.getElementById('galleryImageFiles');
            const albumSelect = document.getElementById('targetAlbumSelect');
            const targetAlbum = albumSelect.value;

            if (!fileInput.files || fileInput.files.length === 0) {
                showSuccessModal('تنبيه', 'يرجى اختيار صورة واحدة على الأقل.', '⚠️');
                return;
            }

            btn.disabled = true;
            const files = Array.from(fileInput.files);
            const totalFiles = files.length;
            btn.innerHTML = `<span>جاري رفع ${totalFiles} صورة بسرعة...</span> ⏳`;

            try {
                const uploadPromises = files.map(async (file, i) => {
                    const filePath = `gallery_uploads/${Date.now()}_${i}_${file.name}`;
                    const { error: upErr } = await supabaseClient.storage.from('media').upload(filePath, file);
                    if (upErr) throw upErr;

                    const { data: pubData } = supabaseClient.storage.from('media').getPublicUrl(filePath);
                    return {
                        image_url: pubData.publicUrl,
                        album: targetAlbum
                    };
                });

                const galleryItemsToInsert = await Promise.all(uploadPromises);
                const { error: dbErr } = await supabaseClient.from('gallery').insert(galleryItemsToInsert);
                if (dbErr) throw dbErr;

                showSuccessModal('تم الرفع بنجاح', `تم رفع وحفظ ${totalFiles} صورة في ألبوم (${targetAlbum}) بنجاح!`, '🚀');
                document.getElementById('uploadGalleryForm').reset();
                loadGalleryFromSupabase();
            } catch (err) {
                showSuccessModal('تعذر الرفع', 'حدث خطأ: ' + err.message, '❌');
            } finally {
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.innerHTML = '<span>رفع وحفظ الصور المحددة</span><span>🚀</span>';
            }
        }

        async function deleteGalleryItem(id) {
            const { error } = await supabaseClient.from('gallery').delete().eq('id', id);
            if (!error) {
                showSuccessModal('تم الحذف', 'تم حذف الصورة من المعرض بنجاح.', '🗑️');
                loadGalleryFromSupabase();
            } else {
                showSuccessModal('خطأ', 'تعذر حذف الصورة.', '❌');
            }
        }

        // --- دوال المحادثة الذكية وصوت النطق الواضح (Text-to-Speech المحدث) ---
        let isVoiceOutputEnabled = true;
        let recognition = null;
        let isRecording = false;

        function toggleVoiceOutput() {
            isVoiceOutputEnabled = !isVoiceOutputEnabled;
            const statusEl = document.getElementById('voiceStatusText');
            statusEl.innerText = isVoiceOutputEnabled ? 'مفعل (صوت واضح وفصيح)' : 'متوقف';
            showSuccessModal('إعدادات الصوت', isVoiceOutputEnabled ? 'تم تفعيل الرد الصوتي الواضح.' : 'تم إيقاف الرد الصوتي.', '🔊');
        }

        function setAiPrompt(prefixText) {
            const input = document.getElementById('aiInputMessage');
            input.value = prefixText;
            input.focus();
        }

        function toggleSpeechRecognition() {
            const micBtn = document.getElementById('micBtn');
            const SpeechRecognition = window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
            
            if (!SpeechRecognition) {
                showSuccessModal('تنبيه', 'متصفحك لا يدعم الإدخال الصوتي، يرجى استخدام متصفح كروم.', '⚠️');
                return;
            }

            if (isRecording) {
                if (recognition) recognition.stop();
                isRecording = false;
                micBtn.style.background = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)';
                return;
            }

            recognition = new SpeechRecognition();
            recognition.lang = 'ar-SA';
            recognition.interimResults = false;
            recognition.maxAlternatives = 1;

            recognition.onstart = function() {
                isRecording = true;
                micBtn.style.background = 'var(--brand-red)';
                micBtn.style.boxShadow = '0 0 15px rgba(255, 77, 45, 0.8)';
            };

            recognition.onresult = function(event) {
                const speechToText = event.results[0][0].transcript;
                document.getElementById('aiInputMessage').value = speechToText;
                sendAiMessage(new Event('submit'));
            };

            recognition.onerror = function() {
                isRecording = false;
                micBtn.style.background = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)';
            };

            recognition.onend = function() {
                isRecording = false;
                micBtn.style.background = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)';
            };

            recognition.start();
        }

        // دالة نطق محسنة بالكامل وواضحة جداً
        function speakSaudiVoice(text) {
            if (!isVoiceOutputEnabled || !('speechSynthesis' in window)) return;
            window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
            
            const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
            utterance.lang = 'ar-SA';
            utterance.rate = 0.92; // سرعة أبطأ قليلاً لتكون مخارج الحروف واضحة ومفهومة 100%
            utterance.pitch = 1.0; // نبرة طبيعية وواضحة

            // محاولة التقاط أفضل صوت عربي متوفر في نظام جهازك
            const voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices();
            const bestVoice = voices.find(v => v.lang === 'ar-SA' || v.lang === 'ar-EG' || v.lang.startsWith('ar'));
            if (bestVoice) {
                utterance.voice = bestVoice;
            }

            window.speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
        }

        // تحديث قائمة الأصوات في المتصفح تلقائياً فور تحميلها
        if ('speechSynthesis' in window) {
            window.speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged = () => {
                window.speechSynthesis.getVoices();
            };
        }

        // محادثة مستمرة مع سجل سياق، عبر Supabase Edge Function آمن
        const AI_HISTORY_LIMIT = 24;
        let aiConversationHistory = [];
        let aiRequestInProgress = false;

        function getAiStorageKey() {
            const userId = currentUser && currentUser.id ? currentUser.id : 'guest';
            return `mtu_ai_chat_v1_${userId}`;
        }

        function loadAiConversation() {
            try {
                const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(getAiStorageKey()) || '[]');
                aiConversationHistory = Array.isArray(saved)
                    ? saved.filter(m => m && ['user', 'assistant'].includes(m.role) && typeof m.content === 'string').slice(-AI_HISTORY_LIMIT)
                    : [];
            } catch (_) {
                aiConversationHistory = [];
            }
            renderAiConversation();
        }

        function saveAiConversation() {
            try {
                localStorage.setItem(getAiStorageKey(), JSON.stringify(aiConversationHistory.slice(-AI_HISTORY_LIMIT)));
            } catch (err) {
                console.warn('تعذر حفظ سجل المحادثة محلياً:', err);
            }
        }

        function appendChatBubble(role, content, options = {}) {
            const chatContainer = document.getElementById('aiChatContainer');
            const bubble = document.createElement('div');
            const isUser = role === 'user';
            bubble.style.cssText = [
                'padding:12px',
                'border-radius:10px',
                'max-width:90%',
                'align-self:' + (isUser ? 'flex-end' : 'flex-start'),
                'color:#fff',
                'font-size:.9rem',
                'white-space:pre-wrap',
                'overflow-wrap:anywhere',
                isUser
                    ? 'background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid var(--border)'
                    : 'background:rgba(59,130,246,.1);border:1px solid rgba(59,130,246,.2)'
            ].join(';');

            if (options.id) bubble.id = options.id;

            const label = document.createElement('strong');
            label.textContent = isUser ? 'أنت: ' : 'المساعد الذكي: ';
            bubble.appendChild(label);
            bubble.appendChild(document.createTextNode(content));
            chatContainer.appendChild(bubble);
            chatContainer.scrollTop = chatContainer.scrollHeight;
            return bubble;
        }

        function renderAiConversation() {
            const chatContainer = document.getElementById('aiChatContainer');
            if (!chatContainer) return;
            chatContainer.replaceChildren();

            if (aiConversationHistory.length === 0) {
                appendChatBubble('assistant', 'أهلاً بك! أنا مساعد منصة النادي الإعلامي. أقدر أساعدك في الأفكار والتقارير والدعم الفني، ونقدر نكمل الحديث خطوة بخطوة. وش ودك نبدأ فيه؟');
                return;
            }

            aiConversationHistory.forEach(message => appendChatBubble(message.role, message.content));
        }

        function clearAiConversation() {
            if (aiRequestInProgress) {
                showSuccessModal('لحظة واحدة', 'انتظر حتى ينتهي الرد الحالي قبل مسح المحادثة.', '⏳');
                return;
            }
            aiConversationHistory = [];
            saveAiConversation();
            renderAiConversation();
            if ('speechSynthesis' in window) window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
        }

        function setAiPrompt(prefixText) {
            const input = document.getElementById('aiInputMessage');
            input.value = prefixText;
            input.focus();
        }

        async function sendAiMessage(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            if (aiRequestInProgress) return;

            const input = document.getElementById('aiInputMessage');
            const chatContainer = document.getElementById('aiChatContainer');
            const sendButton = document.querySelector('#aiChatForm button[type="submit"]');
            const userText = input.value.trim();
            if (!userText) return;

            // لا نستخدم innerHTML مع نص المستخدم لتجنب إدخال HTML غير موثوق.
            aiConversationHistory.push({ role: 'user', content: userText });
            aiConversationHistory = aiConversationHistory.slice(-AI_HISTORY_LIMIT);
            saveAiConversation();
            appendChatBubble('user', userText);
            input.value = '';

            const loadingId = 'ai-loading-' + Date.now();
            const loadingBubble = appendChatBubble('assistant', 'أفكر في رد مناسب... ⏳', { id: loadingId });
            loadingBubble.style.opacity = '0.75';
            aiRequestInProgress = true;
            input.disabled = true;
            if (sendButton) {
                sendButton.disabled = true;
                sendButton.style.opacity = '0.65';
            }

            try {
                // تستدعي هذه الدالة Supabase Edge Function؛ لا تضع مفتاح مزود الذكاء الاصطناعي في المتصفح.
                const messagesForModel = aiConversationHistory.slice(-16).map(({ role, content }) => ({ role, content }));
                const { data, error } = await supabaseClient.functions.invoke('ai-chat', {
                    body: { messages: messagesForModel }
                });

                if (error) {
                    let detail = error.message || 'تعذر الاتصال بخدمة الذكاء الاصطناعي.';
                    try {
                        if (error.context && typeof error.context.json === 'function') {
                            const body = await error.context.json();
                            if (body && body.error) detail = body.error;
                        }
                    } catch (_) {}
                    throw new Error(detail);
                }

                const aiReply = data && typeof data.reply === 'string' ? data.reply.trim() : '';
                if (!aiReply) throw new Error('وصل رد فارغ من خدمة الذكاء الاصطناعي.');

                const loadingEl = document.getElementById(loadingId);
                if (loadingEl) loadingEl.remove();

                aiConversationHistory.push({ role: 'assistant', content: aiReply });
                aiConversationHistory = aiConversationHistory.slice(-AI_HISTORY_LIMIT);
                saveAiConversation();
                appendChatBubble('assistant', aiReply);
                speakSaudiVoice(aiReply);
            } catch (err) {
                const loadingEl = document.getElementById(loadingId);
                if (loadingEl) loadingEl.remove();

                // إزالة رسالة المستخدم من سجل السياق إذا فشل الطلب حتى لا يتراكم سياق غير مكتمل.
                const lastMessage = aiConversationHistory[aiConversationHistory.length - 1];
                if (lastMessage && lastMessage.role === 'user' && lastMessage.content === userText) {
                    aiConversationHistory.pop();
                    saveAiConversation();
                }

                const message = (err && err.message) ? err.message : 'حدث خطأ غير معروف.';
                appendChatBubble('assistant',
                    'ما قدرت أتصل بخدمة الذكاء الاصطناعي حالياً. تأكد من نشر Supabase Edge Function باسم ai-chat وإضافة أسرار الخدمة حسب ملف SETUP_AI.md.\\n\\nالتفاصيل: ' + message);
                console.error('AI chat error:', err);
            } finally {
                aiRequestInProgress = false;
                input.disabled = false;
                if (sendButton) {
                    sendButton.disabled = false;
                    sendButton.style.opacity = '1';
                }
                input.focus();
                chatContainer.scrollTop = chatContainer.scrollHeight;
            }
        }

        // ---------------------------------------------


        // تهيئة سجل المحادثة عند فتح الصفحة. سجل كل حساب مفصول محلياً حسب معرفه.
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            loadAiConversation();
        });

        function checkBoardIdentity(val) {
            if (!isRegisterMode) return;
            const trackGroup = document.getElementById('trackGroup');
            const boardNotice = document.getElementById('boardNotice');
            const cleanVal = val.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');

            if (!cleanVal) {
                trackGroup.style.display = 'block';
                boardNotice.style.display = 'none';
                return;
            }

            const isAdmin = ADMIN_NAMES.some(name => {
                const parts = name.split(' ');
                return cleanVal.includes(parts[0]) && cleanVal.includes(parts[parts.length - 1]);
            });

            const isBoard = BOARD_NAMES.some(name => {
                const parts = name.split(' ');
                return cleanVal.includes(parts[0]) && cleanVal.includes(parts[parts.length - 1]);
            });

            if (isAdmin || isBoard) {
                trackGroup.style.display = 'none';
                boardNotice.style.display = 'block';
            } else {
                trackGroup.style.display = 'block';
                boardNotice.style.display = 'none';
            }
        }

        function toggleAuthMode() {
            isRegisterMode = !isRegisterMode;
            document.getElementById('authMainTitle').innerText = isRegisterMode ? 'إنشاء حساب على المنصة' : 'تسجيل الدخول للمنصة';
            document.getElementById('authBtnText').innerText = isRegisterMode ? 'إنشاء الحساب' : 'دخول المنصة';
            document.getElementById('fullNameGroup').style.display = isRegisterMode ? 'block' : 'none';
            document.getElementById('phoneGroup').style.display = isRegisterMode ? 'block' : 'none';
            
            if (!isRegisterMode) {
                document.getElementById('trackGroup').style.display = 'none';
                document.getElementById('boardNotice').style.display = 'none';
            } else {
                checkBoardIdentity(document.getElementById('authFullName').value);
            }

            document.getElementById('switchText').innerText = isRegisterMode ? 'لديك حساب بالفعل؟' : 'ليس لديك حساب على المنصة؟';
            document.getElementById('switchLink').innerText = isRegisterMode ? 'تسجيل الدخول' : 'إنشاء حساب جديد';
            document.getElementById('authError').innerText = '';
        }

        function openClubRegisterModal() {
            document.getElementById('clubRegModal').style.display = 'flex';
        }

        function closeClubRegisterModal() {
            document.getElementById('clubRegModal').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('clubRegisterForm').reset();
            document.getElementById('regError').innerText = '';
        }

        async function submitClubRegistration(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const btn = document.getElementById('regSubmitBtn');
            const errorEl = document.getElementById('regError');
            errorEl.innerText = '';
            btn.disabled = true;
            btn.innerHTML = '<span>جاري الإرسال...</span> ⏳';

            const regData = {
                full_name: document.getElementById('regFullName').value.trim(),
                email: document.getElementById('regUnivEmail').value.trim(),
                phone: document.getElementById('regPhone').value.trim(),

            };

            } catch (err) {
                errorEl.innerText = '❌ تعذر إرسال الطلب: ' + err.message;
            } finally {
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.innerHTML = '<span>إرسال طلب الانضمام</span><span>📩</span>';

        async function handleSupabaseAuth(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const email = document.getElementById('authEmail').value.trim();
            const password = document.getElementById('authPassword').value;
            const fullName = document.getElementById('authFullName').value.trim();
            const phone = document.getElementById('authPhone').value.trim();
            const track = document.getElementById('authTrack').value;
            const errorEl = document.getElementById('authError');
            const btn = document.getElementById('authBtn');

            errorEl.innerText = '';
            if (!email || !password) {
                errorEl.innerText = 'أدخل البريد الإلكتروني وكلمة المرور.';
                return;
            }
            if (isRegisterMode && !fullName) {
                errorEl.innerText = 'أدخل اسمك الكامل لإنشاء الحساب.';
                return;
            }

            btn.disabled = true;
            btn.innerHTML = '<span>جاري المعالجة...</span> ⏳';

            try {
                if (isRegisterMode) {
                    const isAdminUser = ADMIN_NAMES.some(name => {
                        const parts = name.split(' ');
                        return fullName.includes(parts[0]) && fullName.includes(parts[parts.length - 1]);
                    });
                    const isBoardUser = BOARD_NAMES.some(name => {
                        const parts = name.split(' ');
                        return fullName.includes(parts[0]) && fullName.includes(parts[parts.length - 1]);
                    });

                    let assignedRole = 'member';
                    let assignedTrack = track;
                    if (isAdminUser) {
                        assignedRole = 'admin';
                        assignedTrack = 'مشرف المنصة';
                    } else if (isBoardUser) {
                        assignedRole = 'board';
                        assignedTrack = 'مجلس الإدارة';
                    }

                    const { data, error } = await supabaseClient.auth.signUp({
                        email,
                        password,
                        options: { data: { full_name: fullName } }
                    });
                    if (error) throw error;

                    if (data.user) {
                        const { error: profileError } = await supabaseClient.from('profiles').upsert({
                            id: data.user.id,
                            full_name: fullName || 'عضو جديد',
                            phone: phone || '',
                            role: assignedRole,
                            track: assignedTrack
                        }, { onConflict: 'id' });
                        if (profileError) console.warn('Profile setup warning:', profileError.message);
                    }

                    // If email confirmation is enabled, signUp succeeds but no session is returned.
                    // Do not immediately try password login and incorrectly report a failure.
                    if (data.user && !data.session) {
                        errorEl.innerText = 'تم إنشاء الحساب. تحقق من بريدك الإلكتروني لتأكيد الحساب، ثم سجّل الدخول.';
                        btn.disabled = false;
                        btn.innerHTML = '<span id="authBtnText">إنشاء الحساب</span> 🚀';
                        return;
                    }

                    if (data.user) {
                        await loadUserProfile(data.user);
                        return;
                    }
                }

                const { data: loginData, error: loginError } = await supabaseClient.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password });
                if (loginError) throw loginError;
                if (loginData.user) await loadUserProfile(loginData.user);
            } catch (err) {
                console.error('Supabase authentication error:', err);
                const rawMessage = (err && err.message) ? err.message : 'خطأ غير معروف أثناء المصادقة.';
                const friendly = {
                    'Invalid login credentials': 'البريد الإلكتروني أو كلمة المرور غير صحيحة.',
                    'Email not confirmed': 'أكد بريدك الإلكتروني أولًا من رسالة Supabase ثم حاول تسجيل الدخول.',
                    'User already registered': 'هذا البريد مسجل مسبقًا. اختر تسجيل الدخول بدل إنشاء حساب جديد.'
                };
                errorEl.innerText = friendly[rawMessage] || rawMessage;
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.innerHTML = '<span id="authBtnText">' + (isRegisterMode ? 'إنشاء الحساب' : 'دخول المنصة') + '</span> 🚀';
            }
        }

        async function loadUserProfile(user) {
            currentUser = user;
            const welcome = document.getElementById('welcomeScreen');
            if (welcome) {
                welcome.style.opacity = '0';
                welcome.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
                setTimeout(() => welcome.style.display = 'none', 500);
            }

            const { data: profile } = await supabaseClient
                .from('profiles')
                .select('*')
                .eq('id', user.id)
                .maybeSingle();

            const name = profile?.full_name || user.email.split('@')[0];
            let role = profile?.role || 'member';
            let track = profile?.track || 'عام';

            const isAdminCheck = ADMIN_NAMES.some(aName => {
                const parts = aName.split(' ');
                return name.includes(parts[0]) && name.includes(parts[parts.length - 1]);
            });

            const isBoardCheck = BOARD_NAMES.some(bName => {
                const parts = bName.split(' ');
                return name.includes(parts[0]) && name.includes(parts[parts.length - 1]);
            });

            if (isAdminCheck) {
                role = 'admin';
                track = 'مشرف المنصة';
            } else if (isBoardCheck) {
                role = 'board';
                track = 'مجلس الإدارة';
            }

            currentProfile = { id:user.id, full_name:name, track, role };
            document.getElementById('barUserName').innerText = name;
            document.getElementById('barUserTrack').innerText = track;
            
            let roleDisplay = 'عضو';
            if (role === 'admin') roleDisplay = 'مشرف (Admin)';
            else if (role === 'board') roleDisplay = 'مجلس الإدارة';
            document.getElementById('barUserRole').innerText = roleDisplay;
            
            document.getElementById('profileDisplayName').innerText = name;
            document.getElementById('authorName').value = name;
            document.getElementById('inputBio').value = profile?.bio || '';
            document.getElementById('inputTrack').value = track;
            document.getElementById('inputPhone').value = profile?.phone || '';
            document.getElementById('inputPortfolio').value = profile?.portfolio_url || '';

            uploadedAvatarBase64 = profile?.avatar_url || '';
            if (uploadedAvatarBase64) {
                document.getElementById('avatarPreviewContainer').innerHTML = `<img src="${uploadedAvatarBase64}" style="width:100%; height:100%; border-radius:50%; object-fit:cover;">`;
            }

            if (role === 'admin') {
                document.getElementById('profileRoleBadge').innerText = 'مشرف (Admin)';
                document.getElementById('adminNavBtn').style.display = 'inline-flex';
                loadAdminMembers();
            } else if (role === 'board') {
                document.getElementById('profileRoleBadge').innerText = 'عضو مجلس الإدارة 🌟';
            } else {
                document.getElementById('profileRoleBadge').innerText = 'عضو (Member)';
            }
            prepareTaskPanel(); loadTasks(); loadEvents(); showUpcomingTaskNotice();
        }

        function previewAvatar(input) {
            if (input.files && input.files[0]) {
                const reader = new FileReader();
                reader.onload = function(e) {
                    const img = new Image();
                    img.src = e.target.result;
                    img.onload = function() {
                        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
                        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
                        const MAX = 200;
                        let w = img.width, h = img.height;
                        if (w > h) { if (w > MAX) { h *= MAX / w; w = MAX; } }
                        else { if (h > MAX) { w *= MAX / h; h = MAX; } }
                        canvas.width = w; canvas.height = h;
                        ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, w, h);
                        uploadedAvatarBase64 = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.7);
                        document.getElementById('avatarPreviewContainer').innerHTML = `<img src="${uploadedAvatarBase64}" style="width:100%; height:100%; border-radius:50%; object-fit:cover;">`;
                    };
                };
                reader.readAsDataURL(input.files[0]);
            }
        }

        async function updateProfile(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            if (!currentUser) return;
            const btn = document.getElementById('saveProfileBtn');
            btn.disabled = true;
            btn.innerHTML = '<span>جاري الحفظ...</span> ⏳';

            const bio = document.getElementById('inputBio').value.trim();
            const track = document.getElementById('inputTrack').value;
            const phone = document.getElementById('inputPhone').value.trim();
            const portfolio_url = document.getElementById('inputPortfolio').value.trim();

            const { error } = await supabaseClient.from('profiles').update({
                bio, track, phone, portfolio_url, avatar_url: uploadedAvatarBase64
            }).eq('id', currentUser.id);

            if (error) {
                showSuccessModal('خطأ في الحفظ', 'تعذر حفظ البروفايل، يرجى المحاولة مرة أخرى.', '❌');
            } else {
                showSuccessModal('تم الحفظ', 'تم تحديث بيانات البروفايل بنجاح!', '💾');
                document.getElementById('barUserTrack').innerText = track;
            }
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.innerHTML = '<span>حفظ التعديلات في البروفايل</span><span>💾</span>';
        }

        async function loadAdminMembers() {
            const container = document.getElementById('adminMembersList');
            const { data: members, error } = await supabaseClient.from('profiles').select('*');
            if (error || !members) {
                container.innerHTML = 'تعذر جلب الأعضاء.';
                return;
            }
            allMembersData = members;
            updateDashboardStats();
            renderMembersList(allMembersData);
        }

        function updateDashboardStats() {
            document.getElementById('statTotalMembers').innerText = allMembersData.length;
            const trackCounts = {};
            allMembersData.forEach(m => {
                const t = m.track || 'غير محدد';
                trackCounts[t] = (trackCounts[t] || 0) + 1;
            });
            let topTrack = 'تحديد...';
            let maxCount = 0;
            for (let t in trackCounts) {
                if (trackCounts[t] > maxCount && t !== 'مشرف المنصة') {
                    maxCount = trackCounts[t];
                    topTrack = t;
                }
            }
            document.getElementById('statTopTrack').innerText = topTrack;
        }

        function renderMembersList(members) {
            const container = document.getElementById('adminMembersList');
            container.innerHTML = '';
            if (members.length === 0) {
                container.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center; color:var(--text-muted); padding:15px;">لا يوجد أعضاء.</div>';
                return;
            }
            members.forEach(m => {
                const item = document.createElement('div');
                item.className = 'member-row-item';
                item.innerHTML = `
                    <div>
                        <strong>${m.full_name || 'بدون اسم'}</strong><br>
                        <span style="font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--text-muted);">المسار: ${m.track || 'غير محدد'} | الجوال: ${m.phone || 'غير مسجل'}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div style="display:flex; gap:5px; align-items:center;">
                        <select id="track_${m.id}" style="padding:4px 8px; font-size:0.8rem;">
                            <option value="تصوير وإضاءة" ${m.track==='تصوير وإضاءة'?'selected':''}>تصوير وإضاءة</option>
                            <option value="مونتاج وموشن جرافيك" ${m.track==='مونتاج وموشن جرافيك'?'selected':''}>مونتاج</option>
                            <option value="إنتاج برامج وبودكاست" ${m.track==='إنتاج برامج وبودكاست'?'selected':''}>بودكاست</option>
                            <option value="تصميم وهوية بصرية" ${m.track==='تصميم وهوية بصرية'?'selected':''}>تصميم</option>
                            <option value="كتابة وصحافة إعلامية" ${m.track==='كتابة وصحافة إعلامية'?'selected':''}>كتابة</option>
                            <option value="تقنية المعلومات (IT)" ${m.track==='تقنية المعلومات (IT)'?'selected':''}>IT</option>
                            <option value="مجلس الإدارة" ${m.track==='مجلس الإدارة'?'selected':''}>مجلس الإدارة</option>
                        </select>
                        <button onclick="changeMemberTrack('${m.id}')" style="background:var(--accent-primary); border:none; color:#fff; padding:5px 10px; border-radius:6px; cursor:pointer; font-size:0.75rem;">تحديث</button>
                    </div>
                `;
                container.appendChild(item);
            });
        }

        function filterMembersList() {
            const selectedTrack = document.getElementById('filterTrackSelect').value;
            if (selectedTrack === 'الكل') {
                renderMembersList(allMembersData);
            } else {
                renderMembersList(allMembersData.filter(m => m.track === selectedTrack));
            }
        }

        function sendGroupSMS() {
            const targetTrack = document.getElementById('smsTargetTrack').value;
            const msg = document.getElementById('smsMessageText').value.trim();
            if (!msg) { showSuccessModal('تنبيه', 'يرجى كتابة نص الرسالة أولاً.', '⚠️'); return; }

            const filtered = targetTrack === 'جميع المسارات' ? allMembersData : allMembersData.filter(m => m.track === targetTrack);
            const phones = filtered.map(m => m.phone).filter(p => p && p.length >= 9);
            if (phones.length === 0) { showSuccessModal('تنبيه', 'لا توجد أرقام جوالات مسجلة هذا المسار.', 'ℹ️'); return; }

            window.location.href = `sms:${phones.join(',')}?body=${encodeURIComponent(msg)}`;
        }

        function exportMembersToExcel() {
            if (allMembersData.length === 0) return;
            let csv = "data:text/csv;charset=utf-8,\uFEFFالاسم,المسار,الرتبة,الجوال\n";
            allMembersData.forEach(m => { csv += `"${m.full_name || ''}","${m.track || ''}","${m.role || ''}","${m.phone || ''}"\n`; });
            const link = document.createElement("a");
            link.setAttribute("href", encodeURI(csv));
            link.setAttribute("download", `اعضاء_النادي_${`${new Date().getFullYear()}-${String(new Date().getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(new Date().getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}`}.csv`);
            document.body.appendChild(link); link.click(); document.body.removeChild(link);
        }

        async function changeMemberTrack(userId) {
            const newTrack = document.getElementById(`track_${userId}`).value;
            const { error } = await supabaseClient.from('profiles').update({ track: newTrack }).eq('id', userId);
            if (!error) { showSuccessModal('تم التحديث', 'تم تغيير مسار العضو بنجاح!', '✨'); loadAdminMembers(); }
        }

        async function logout() {
            await supabaseClient.auth.signOut();
            window.location.reload();
        }

        // Tasks, calendar events, notifications, and bilingual controls.

        let selectedCalendarDate = `${new Date().getFullYear()}-${String(new Date().getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(new Date().getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}`;

        let cachedMembersForTasks = [];

        const UI_EN = {

found.','أعضاء النادي':'Club members','عن النادي':'About the club','المسارات الإعلامية':'Media tracks','تواصل معنا':'Contact us','جميع المسارات':'All tracks','مجلس الإدارة':'Club Council'
        };
        const STATIC_AR = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(STATIC_EN).map(([ar,en])=>[en,ar]));
        function translateStaticText(){
          const map=currentUiLanguage==='en'?STATIC_EN:STATIC_AR;
          const walker=document.createTreeWalker(document.body,NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT,{acceptNode(node){
            if(!node.nodeValue || !node.nodeValue.trim()) return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
            const parent=node.parentElement;
            if(!parent || ['SCRIPT','STYLE','NOSCRIPT','TEXTAREA'].includes(parent.tagName)) return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
            if(parent.closest('[data-i18n]')) return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;
            return NodeFilter.FILTER_ACCEPT;
          }});
          const nodes=[];while(walker.nextNode())nodes.push(walker.currentNode);
          nodes.forEach(node=>{const raw=node.nodeValue,trimmed=raw.trim();if(map[trimmed])node.nodeValue=raw.replace(trimmed,map[trimmed]);});
          document.querySelectorAll('input[placeholder],textarea[placeholder]').forEach(el=>{
            const ar=el.dataset.placeholderAr || el.getAttribute('placeholder');
            if(!el.dataset.placeholderAr)el.dataset.placeholderAr=ar;
            const en=STATIC_EN[ar];el.setAttribute('placeholder',currentUiLanguage==='en'?(en||ar):(STATIC_AR[el.dataset.placeholderEn||'']||ar));
            if(en)el.dataset.placeholderEn=en;
          });
        }
        function applyLanguage(){
          document.documentElement.lang=currentUiLanguage;
          document.documentElement.dir=currentUiLanguage==='en'?'ltr':'rtl';
          const toggle=document.getElementById('languageToggle');if(toggle)toggle.textContent=currentUiLanguage==='en'?'عربي':'EN';
          document.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n]').forEach(el=>{const k=el.getAttribute('data-i18n');const dict=currentUiLanguage==='en'?UI_EN:UI_AR;if(dict[k])el.textContent=dict[k];});
          const nav=document.querySelectorAll('.quick-nav .nav-btn');
          const keys=['navHome','navProfile','navIdea','navArchive','navGallery','navTasks','navCalendar','navAI','navAdmin','navLogout'];
          nav.forEach((b,i)=>{if(keys[i])b.textContent=tx(keys[i]);});
          translateStaticText();
          renderCalendar();
        }
        function toggleLanguage(){
          currentUiLanguage=currentUiLanguage==='ar'?'en':'ar';
          try{localStorage.setItem('mtu_ui_language',currentUiLanguage);}catch(e){}
          applyLanguage();
          loadTasks();loadEvents();
        }
        function isPlatformSupervisor(){return !!currentProfile && (currentProfile.role==='admin' || currentProfile.track==='مشرف المنصة');}
        function safeText(value){return String(value??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,ch=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[ch]));}
        async function fetchTaskMembers(){
          const {data,error}=await supabaseClient.from('profiles').select('id,full_name,track,role').order('full_name');
          if(error){console.warn('Unable to load profiles for task assignment',error);return [];}return data||[];
        }
        async function prepareTaskPanel(){
          const panel=document.getElementById('taskCreatePanel'), eventPanel=document.getElementById('eventCreatePanel');
          if(panel)panel.style.display=isPlatformSupervisor()?'block':'none';if(eventPanel)eventPanel.style.display=isPlatformSupervisor()?'block':'none';
          if(!isPlatformSupervisor())return;
          cachedMembersForTasks=await fetchTaskMembers();
          const list=document.getElementById('taskPeopleList');if(list)list.innerHTML=cachedMembersForTasks.map(m=>`<label><input type="checkbox" value="${safeText(m.id)}"> <span>${safeText(m.full_name||'عضو')} <small style="color:#a9b9b0">· ${safeText(m.track||'عام')}</small></span></label>`).join('')||'<span>لا يوجد أعضاء.</span>';
        }
        async function createTask(){
          const title=document.getElementById('taskTitle').value.trim(),description=document.getElementById('taskDescription').value.trim(),target=document.getElementById('taskTrack').value,due=document.getElementById('taskDue').value;
          const msg=document.getElementById('taskFormMessage');
          if(!isPlatformSupervisor()){msg.textContent=tx('adminOnly');return;}if(!title){msg.textContent=currentUiLanguage==='en'?'Enter a task title first.':'اكتب عنوان التكليف أولاً.';return;}
          let selected=[];
          if(target==='__individual__')selected=[...document.querySelectorAll('#taskPeopleList input:checked')].map(x=>x.value);
          else selected=cachedMembersForTasks.filter(m=>target==='جميع المسارات'||m.track===target||(target==='مجلس الإدارة'&&m.role==='board')).map(m=>m.id);
          if(!selected.length){msg.textContent=currentUiLanguage==='en'?'Select at least one member or track.':'حدد شخصًا واحدًا على الأقل أو اختر مسارًا.';return;}
          msg.textContent=currentUiLanguage==='en'?'Saving assignment…':'جاري حفظ التكليف…';
          const rows=selected.map(uid=>({title,description,assigned_to:uid,assigned_by:currentProfile.id,target_track:target==='__individual__'?'أشخاص محددون':target,due_date:due||null,status:'not_started'}));
          const {error}=await supabaseClient.from('club_tasks').insert(rows);
          if(error){console.error(error);msg.textContent=(currentUiLanguage==='en'?'Could not save. Run the SQL setup file first. ':'تعذر الحفظ. نفّذ ملف إعداد قاعدة البيانات SQL أولاً. ')+error.message;return;}
          document.getElementById('taskTitle').value='';document.getElementById('taskDescription').value='';document.querySelectorAll('#taskPeopleList input').forEach(x=>x.checked=false);msg.textContent=tx('taskSaved');await loadTasks();
        }
        async function loadTasks(){
          const target=document.getElementById('myTasksList');if(!target)return;
          if(!currentProfile){target.innerHTML=`<p>${tx('needLogin')}</p>`;return;}
          const {data,error}=await supabaseClient.from('club_tasks').select('id,title,description,assigned_to,assigned_by,due_date,status,created_at').eq('assigned_to',currentProfile.id).order('created_at',{ascending:false});
          if(error){target.innerHTML=`<p style="color:#d8b56a">${currentUiLanguage==='en'?'Task database not configured yet.':'قاعدة بيانات التكليفات تحتاج إلى الإعداد.'} ${safeText(error.message)}</p>`;return;}
          if(!data?.length){target.innerHTML=`<p style="color:#b6c8bd">${tx('taskEmpty')}</p>`;return;}
          target.innerHTML=data.map(t=>`<article class="task-item"><h4>${safeText(t.title)}</h4><p>${safeText(t.description||'')}</p><div class="item-meta"><span>${tx('due')}: ${safeText(t.due_date||'—')}</span><span class="status-pill">${tx('taskStatus')}: ${statusLabel(t.status)}</span></div><label style="font-size:12px;color:#e6c879;margin-top:10px;display:block">${currentUiLanguage==='en'?'Update progress':'تحديث الإنجاز'} <select onchange="updateTaskStatus('${safeText(t.id)}',this.value)"><option value="not_started" ${t.status==='not_started'?'selected':''}>${tx('notStarted')}</option><option value="in_progress" ${t.status==='in_progress'?'selected':''}>${tx('inProgress')}</option><option value="completed" ${t.status==='completed'?'selected':''}>${tx('completed')}</option></select></label></article>`).join('');
        }
        function statusLabel(s){return tx(s==='completed'?'completed':s==='in_progress'?'inProgress':'notStarted');}
        async function updateTaskStatus(id,status){const {error}=await supabaseClient.from('club_tasks').update({status,updated_at:new Date().toISOString()}).eq('id',id).eq('assigned_to',currentProfile.id);if(error)alert((currentUiLanguage==='en'?'Update failed: ':'فشل تحديث الحالة: ')+error.message);else loadTasks();}
        async function createEvent(){
          const msg=document.getElementById('eventFormMessage');if(!isPlatformSupervisor()){msg.textContent=tx('adminOnly');return;}
          const title=document.getElementById('eventTitle').value.trim(),date=document.getElementById('eventDate').value,start=document.getElementById('eventStart').value,end=document.getElementById('eventEnd').value,target=document.getElementById('eventTarget').value;
          if(!title||!date||!start){msg.textContent=currentUiLanguage==='en'?'Add a title, date and start time.':'أدخل العنوان والتاريخ ووقت البداية.';return;}if(end&&end<start){msg.textContent=currentUiLanguage==='en'?'End time must follow start time.':'يجب أن يكون وقت النهاية بعد البداية.';return;}
          msg.textContent=currentUiLanguage==='en'?'Saving…':'جاري الحفظ…';
          const {error}=await supabaseClient.from('club_events').insert({title,event_date:date,start_time:start,end_time:end||null,location:document.getElementById('eventLocation').value.trim(),notes:document.getElementById('eventNotes').value.trim(),target_track:target,created_by:currentProfile.id});
          if(error){msg.textContent=(currentUiLanguage==='en'?'Could not save. Run the SQL setup file first. ':'تعذر الحفظ. نفّذ ملف إعداد قاعدة البيانات SQL أولاً. ')+error.message;return;}
          msg.textContent=tx('eventSaved');selectedCalendarDate=date;document.getElementById('eventDate').value=date;await loadEvents();renderCalendar();renderSelectedDayEvents();
        }
        let cachedEvents=[];
        async function loadEvents(){const {data,error}=await supabaseClient.from('club_events').select('*').order('event_date');if(error){cachedEvents=[];const n=document.getElementById('selectedDayEvents');if(n)n.innerHTML=`<p style="color:#d8b56a">${currentUiLanguage==='en'?'Calendar database not configured yet.':'قاعدة بيانات التقويم تحتاج إلى الإعداد.'}</p>`;renderCalendar();return;}cachedEvents=data||[];renderCalendar();renderSelectedDayEvents();showUpcomingMeetingNotice();}
        function renderCalendar(){
          const grid=document.getElementById('calendarGrid'),label=document.getElementById('calendarMonthLabel');if(!grid||!label)return;
          const year=currentCalendarDate.getFullYear(),month=currentCalendarDate.getMonth();label.textContent=new Intl.DateTimeFormat(currentUiLanguage==='en'?'en-US':'ar-SA-u-ca-gregory',{month:'long',year:'numeric'}).format(new Date(year,month,1));
          const dayNames=currentUiLanguage==='en'?['Sun','Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat']:['ح','ن','ث','ر','خ','ج','س'];grid.innerHTML=dayNames.map(d=>`<div class="calendar-day-name">${d}</div>`).join('');
          const first=new Date(year,month,1).getDay(),days=new Date(year,month+1,0).getDate(),prevDays=new Date(year,month,0).getDate(),today=`${new Date().getFullYear()}-${String(new Date().getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(new Date().getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}`;
          for(let i=0;i<42;i++){let day,date,muted=false;if(i<first){day=prevDays-first+i+1;date=new Date(year,month-1,day);muted=true;}else if(i>=first+days){day=i-first-days+1;date=new Date(year,month+1,day);muted=true;}else{day=i-first+1;date=new Date(year,month,day);}const key=`${date.getFullYear()}-${String(date.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(date.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}`,has=cachedEvents.some(e=>e.event_date===key&&(e.target_track==='جميع المسارات'||e.target_track===currentProfile?.track||e.target_track==='مجلس الإدارة'&&['admin','board'].includes(currentProfile?.role)));grid.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',`<button class="calendar-day ${muted?'muted':''} ${key===today?'today':''} ${key===selectedCalendarDate?'selected':''} ${has?'has-event':''}" onclick="selectCalendarDay('${key}')">${day}</button>`);}
        }
        function changeCalendarMonth(delta){currentCalendarDate=new Date(currentCalendarDate.getFullYear(),currentCalendarDate.getMonth()+delta,1);renderCalendar();}
        function selectCalendarDay(date){selectedCalendarDate=date;document.getElementById('eventDate').value=date;renderCalendar();renderSelectedDayEvents();}
        function renderSelectedDayEvents(){const box=document.getElementById('selectedDayEvents');if(!box)return;const events=cachedEvents.filter(e=>e.event_date===selectedCalendarDate&&(e.target_track==='جميع المسارات'||e.target_track===currentProfile?.track||e.target_track==='مجلس الإدارة'&&['admin','board'].includes(currentProfile?.role)));if(!events.length){box.innerHTML=`<p style="color:#b6c8bd">${tx('eventEmpty')}</p>`;return;}box.innerHTML=events.map(e=>`<article class="event-item"><h4>${safeText(e.title)}</h4><div class="item-meta"><span>🕒 ${safeText((e.start_time||'').slice(0,5))}${e.end_time?' – '+safeText(e.end_time.slice(0,5)):''}</span><span>📍 ${safeText(e.location||'—')}</span></div>${e.notes?`<p>${safeText(e.notes)}</p>`:''}</article>`).join('');}
        function showUpcomingMeetingNotice(){const box=document.getElementById('meetingNoticeArea');if(!box||!currentProfile)return;const now=new Date();const todayLocal=`${now.getFullYear()}-${String(now.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(now.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}`;const upcoming=cachedEvents.filter(e=>{const matches=e.target_track==='جميع المسارات'||e.target_track===currentProfile.track||(e.target_track==='مجلس الإدارة'&&['admin','board'].includes(currentProfile.role));const stamp=new Date(`${e.event_date}T${(e.start_time||'00:00').slice(0,5)}:00`);return matches&&e.event_date>=todayLocal&&stamp>=now;}).sort((a,b)=>(a.event_date+(a.start_time||'00:00')).localeCompare(b.event_date+(b.start_time||'00:00')))[0];if(!upcoming){box.innerHTML='';return;}const key='mtu_event_seen_'+currentProfile.id+'_'+upcoming.id;if(!sessionStorage.getItem(key)){box.innerHTML=`<div class="notice-banner"><span style="font-size:24px">🔔</span><div><strong>${tx('meetingSoon')}: ${safeText(upcoming.title)}</strong><p>${safeText(upcoming.event_date)} · ${safeText((upcoming.start_time||'').slice(0,5))} ${safeText(upcoming.location||'')}</p></div><button class="soft-action" onclick="this.parentElement.remove();sessionStorage.setItem('${key}','1')">${currentUiLanguage==='en'?'Dismiss':'إغلاق'}</button></div>`;}}
        function showUpcomingTaskNotice(){const box=document.getElementById('taskNoticeArea');if(!box||!currentProfile)return;supabaseClient.from('club_tasks').select('id,title,due_date').eq('assigned_to',currentProfile.id).neq('status','completed').order('created_at',{ascending:false}).limit(1).then(({data,error})=>{if(error||!data?.length)return;const t=data[0],key='mtu_task_seen_'+currentProfile.id+'_'+t.id;if(!sessionStorage.getItem(key))box.innerHTML=`<div class="notice-banner"><span style="font-size:24px">📌</span><div><strong>${currentUiLanguage==='en'?'New assignment':'لديك تكليف' }: ${safeText(t.title)}</strong><p>${tx('due')}: ${safeText(t.due_date||'—')}</p></div><button class="soft-action" onclick="this.parentElement.remove();sessionStorage.setItem('${key}','1')">${currentUiLanguage==='en'?'Dismiss':'إغلاق'}</button>`;});}
        window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',()=>{applyLanguage();const d=document.getElementById('eventDate');if(d)d.value=selectedCalendarDate;renderCalendar();});

        window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async () => {
            loadGalleryFromSupabase();
            const { data: { session } } = await supabaseClient.auth.getSession();
            if (session && session.user) { loadUserProfile(session.user); }
        });

        window.switchPage = function(pageId, btnElement) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.page-section').forEach(sec => sec.classList.remove('active'));
            document.querySelectorAll('.nav-btn').forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));
            const targetPage=document.getElementById(pageId);
            if(!targetPage) return;
            targetPage.classList.add('active');
            if(btnElement) btnElement.classList.add('active');
            window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
            if (pageId === 'archivePage') loadSupabaseIdeas();
            if (pageId === 'adminPage') loadAdminMembers();
            if (pageId === 'galleryPage') loadGalleryFromSupabase();
            if (pageId === 'tasksPage') { prepareTaskPanel(); loadTasks(); showUpcomingTaskNotice(); }
            if (pageId === 'calendarPage') { loadEvents(); renderCalendar(); }
        };

        function getYouTubeEmbedUrl(url) {
            if (!url) return '';
            const match = url.match(/^.*(youtu.be\/|v\/|u\/\w\/|embed\/|watch\?v=|\&v=)([^#\&\?]*).*/);
            return (match && match[2].length === 11) ? `https://www.youtube.com/embed/${match[2]}` : '';
        }

        async function submitIdeaToSupabase(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const btn = document.getElementById('submitBtn');
            btn.disabled = true; btn.innerHTML = '<span>جاري الرفع والحفظ...</span> ⏳';

            let imageUrl = '';
            const imgFile = document.getElementById('ideaImageFile').files[0];

            try {
                if (imgFile) {
                    const filePath = `ideas_images/${Date.now()}_${imgFile.name}`;
                    const { error: upErr } = await supabaseClient.storage.from('media').upload(filePath, imgFile);
                    if (upErr) throw upErr;
                    const { data: pubData } = supabaseClient.storage.from('media').getPublicUrl(filePath);
                    imageUrl = pubData.publicUrl;
                }

                const ideaData = {
                    author: document.getElementById('authorName').value.trim(),
                    title: document.getElementById('ideaTitle').value.trim(),
                    description: document.getElementById('ideaDescription').value.trim(),
                    location: document.getElementById('ideaLocation').value.trim(),
                    members: document.getElementById('ideaMembers').value.trim(),
                    image_url: imageUrl,
                    video_url: document.getElementById('videoUrl').value.trim(),
                    status: 'قيد المراجعة',
                    likes_count: 0
                };

                const { error } = await supabaseClient.from('ideas').insert([ideaData]);
                if (error) throw error;

                showSuccessModal('تمت إضافة الفكرة', 'تم حفظ وتوثيق فكرتك بنجاح في الأرشيف!', '💡');
                document.getElementById('ideaForm').reset();
                document.getElementById('authorName').value = document.getElementById('profileDisplayName').innerText;
                switchPage('archivePage', document.querySelectorAll('.nav-btn')[3]);
            } catch (err) {
                showSuccessModal('خطأ في الحفظ', 'تعذر حفظ الفكرة: ' + err.message, '❌');
            } finally {
                btn.disabled = false; btn.innerHTML = '<span>حفظ الفكرة في السحابة</span><span>🚀</span>';
            }
        }

        async function loadSupabaseIdeas() {
            const container = document.getElementById('archiveContainer');
            const counter = document.getElementById('archiveCount');
            try {
                container.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted); padding: 20px;">جاري التحميل...</div>';
                const { data: ideas, error } = await supabaseClient.from('ideas').select('*').order('created_at', { ascending: false });
                if (error) throw error;

                allIdeasData = ideas;
                counter.textContent = `إجمالي المشاركات: ${ideas.length}`;
                const statTotalIdeas = document.getElementById('statTotalIdeas');
                if (statTotalIdeas) statTotalIdeas.innerText = ideas.length;

                renderIdeasCards(allIdeasData);
            } catch (err) {
                container.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align: center; color: #f85149; padding: 20px;">تعذر جلب الأرشيف.</div>';
            }
        }

        function renderIdeasCards(ideas) {
            const container = document.getElementById('archiveContainer');
            container.innerHTML = ideas.length === 0 ? '<div style="text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted); padding: 20px;">لا توجد أفكار.</div>' : '';

            ideas.forEach((idea) => {
                const embedUrl = getYouTubeEmbedUrl(idea.video_url);
                const statusClass = idea.status === 'معتمدة' ? 'status-approved' : 'status-pending';
                const card = document.createElement('div');
                card.className = 'idea-card';
                card.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="idea-header">
                        <div class="idea-title">${idea.title || ''}</div>
                        <div style="display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center;">
                            <span class="status-badge ${statusClass}">${idea.status || 'قيد المراجعة'}</span>
                            <div class="idea-author">المقترح: ${idea.author || ''}</div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="idea-body">${idea.description || ''}</div>
                    <div class="idea-details-meta">
                        <div>📍 <strong>الموقع:</strong> ${idea.location || ''}</div>
                        <div>👥 <strong>المشاركون:</strong> ${idea.members || ''}</div>
                    </div>
                    ${idea.image_url ? `<div style="margin-top: 10px;"><img src="${idea.image_url}" style="width:100%; max-height:220px; object-fit:cover; border-radius:8px;" onerror="this.style.display='none'"></div>` : ''}
                    ${embedUrl ? `<div class="video-wrapper"><iframe src="${embedUrl}" allowfullscreen></iframe></div>` : ''}
                    <div style="margin-top: 12px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;">
                        <button class="like-btn" onclick="likeIdea('${idea.id}', ${idea.likes_count || 0})">
                            <span>👍 تصويت</span> <strong id="like_count_${idea.id}">${idea.likes_count || 0}</strong>
                        </button>
                        <span style="font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--text-muted);">${new Date(idea.created_at).toLocaleDateString('ar-SA')}</span>
                    </div>
                `;
                container.appendChild(card);
            });
        }

        function filterIdeasArchive() {
            const query = document.getElementById('searchIdeaInput').value.toLowerCase().trim();
            if (!query) { renderIdeasCards(allIdeasData); return; }
            renderIdeasCards(allIdeasData.filter(i => 
                (i.title && i.title.toLowerCase().includes(query)) ||
                (i.author && i.author.toLowerCase().includes(query)) ||
                (i.description && i.description.toLowerCase().includes(query))
            ));
        }

        async function likeIdea(ideaId, currentLikes) {
            const newLikes = currentLikes + 1;
            const countEl = document.getElementById(`like_count_${ideaId}`);
            if (countEl) countEl.innerText = newLikes;
            await supabaseClient.from('ideas').update({ likes_count: newLikes }).eq('id', ideaId);
        }
    </script>

<script>
function openPublicLogin(){
  const landing=document.getElementById('publicLanding');
  const auth=document.getElementById('welcomeScreen');
  if(landing) landing.classList.add('public-hidden');
  if(auth){auth.classList.add('public-auth-open');auth.style.opacity='1';auth.style.pointerEvents='auto';}
  window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'instant'});
}
function returnToPublicLanding(){
  const landing=document.getElementById('publicLanding');
  const auth=document.getElementById('welcomeScreen');
  if(auth){auth.classList.remove('public-auth-open');auth.style.opacity='1';auth.style.pointerEvents='auto';}
  if(landing) landing.classList.remove('public-hidden');
}
</script>

<script id="royalLuxuryMotion">
(function(){
  try {
    const landing=document.getElementById('publicLanding');
    if(!landing) return;
    const revealTargets=landing.querySelectorAll('.public-section,.track-card,.team-photo,.public-archive,.public-cta,.value-strip>div');
    revealTargets.forEach(el=>el.classList.add('js-reveal'));
    if('IntersectionObserver' in window){
      const observer=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>entries.forEach(entry=>{if(entry.isIntersecting){entry.target.classList.add('is-visible');observer.unobserve(entry.target)}}),{threshold:.12,rootMargin:'0px 0px -35px 0px'});
      revealTargets.forEach(el=>observer.observe(el));
    } else { revealTargets.forEach(el=>el.classList.add('is-visible')); }
    // A subtle pointer glow adds depth on desktop without affecting touch screens.
    if(window.matchMedia('(pointer:fine)').matches){
      const hero=landing.querySelector('.public-hero');
      if(hero){hero.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{const r=hero.getBoundingClientRect();hero.style.setProperty('--pointer-x',((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width*100)+'%');hero.style.setProperty('--pointer-y',((e.clientY-r.top)/r.height*100)+'%')},{passive:true});}
    }
    // Keep navigation anchors smooth and close to the sticky header.
    landing.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(a=>a.addEventListener('click',e=>{const target=document.querySelector(a.getAttribute('href'));if(target){e.preventDefault();target.scrollIntoView({behavior:window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches?'auto':'smooth',block:'start'});}}));
  } catch(e) { console.warn('Royal motion enhancement skipped',e); }
})();

        Object.assign(window,{toggleLanguage,createTask,loadTasks,updateTaskStatus,createEvent,loadEvents,changeCalendarMonth,selectCalendarDay});
</script>
</body>
</html>
